title: QA Lead -Salesforce Automation
description:
**Job Description:**

**Senior QA Engineer (Salesforce Test Automation)**

**Experience:** 7–10 Years

**Role:** Senior QA Engineer

**Work Model:** Agile Delivery Pod (client-facing)

**Focus:** Salesforce Automation Testing, Playwright, Selenium, Copado, Test Strategy & Documentation, Client Engagement

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **Senior QA Engineer** with 7–10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a strong focus on **Salesforce testing and test automation**. The candidate will define and execute test strategies, build and maintain automation frameworks, and uphold quality standards across the delivery lifecycle.

The role requires direct engagement with clients. The candidate will take part in requirement discussions, present quality status and risks to client stakeholders, and propose practical suggestions to improve quality and test coverage. The candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, Architects, Scrum Masters and business stakeholders.

**Must Have Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* **MANDATORY:** Strong hands-on experience in **Salesforce automation testing** across Lightning Experience, Apex, flows, and integrated business processes.
* **MANDATORY:** Strong hands-on expertise in **Playwright** for end-to-end test automation (TypeScript or JavaScript preferred).
* Hands-on experience with **Selenium WebDriver** and **Copado** for Salesforce release testing and CI/CD-integrated deployments.
* Experience designing and maintaining reusable automation frameworks (Page Object Model, data-driven and keyword-driven approaches).
* Experience with functional, regression, integration, smoke and UAT support testing, and with API testing using Postman or REST Assured.
* Working knowledge of Git and of integrating automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail or Xray.

**Quality Practices & Documentation**

* Ability to set up the complete testing lifecycle, including test strategy, test plans, environment and test data setup, entry and exit criteria, and traceability matrices.
* Proven adherence to QA best practices such as risk-based testing, shift-left testing, root cause analysis and defect lifecycle management.
* Strong documentation skills, including test strategies, test reports, automation framework guides and runbooks.

**Communication & Client Engagement**

* Ability to communicate directly with clients, presenting test progress, quality metrics, risks and dependencies in a clear and professional manner.
* Ability to ideate with clients and provide well-reasoned suggestions on automation coverage, quality improvements and process optimization.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with comfort in requirement discussions, estimation, and sprint ceremonies within an Agile pod.

**Good to Have Skills**

* **Salesforce Core** experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* **Financial Services Cloud** testing experience, including household and financial account management, relationship management, and compliance-driven workflows.
* Other automation and testing tools such as Provar, Cypress, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber (BDD), Appium, JMeter or Gearset.
* Experience with Apex unit test validation, SOQL and data validation, and sandbox or environment management strategies.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or Financial Services Cloud.
* Experience working with global teams and offshore–onshore delivery models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain automation frameworks for Salesforce and web applications using Playwright, Selenium and Copado.
* Set up and govern the testing process from project inception, including test environments, test data, tooling and quality gates.
* Define test strategies, test plans and test cases aligned to business requirements and process flows.
* Execute functional, regression, integration and smoke testing, and integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Engage directly with clients to clarify requirements, present quality status, and ideate on improvements to coverage and process.
* Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including test reports, defect reports, traceability matrices and automation guides.
* Perform defect triage and root cause analysis, and drive resolution with development teams.
* Support release activities, UAT and production validation, and mentor junior QA engineers on best practices.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience in Salesforce quality assurance and test automation may also be considered. Relevant certifications are preferred.

**Location:**

DGS India - Pune - Indiqube Orchid

**Brand:**

Merkle

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Contract Type:**

Permanent

title: Deputy Manager-Senior Network Operations Engineer - PuneVOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Operations Engineer to join our GNO Enterprise Connectivity-Tech Ops team in Pune. This role is focused on providing expert-level third-line network operations support across a highly resilient and secure enterprise infrastructure. The successful candidate will act as a key escalation point for critical incidents, drive operational excellence, support continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborate with multiple technology and business teams to maintain and enhance network performance, reliability, and security.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Provide third-line support for complex enterprise network environments, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of critical incidents.
* Lead troubleshooting activities across technologies including VRF, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP and Cisco ACI.
* Manage and maintain enterprise network infrastructure consisting of Cisco Catalyst 3700, 3900, 4500 and 9000 series switches, Cisco Nexus 7000 and 9000 platforms, Cisco ASR, Cisco Catalyst Center and Wi-Fi 6/7 wireless networks.
* Monitor network performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve stability, availability and capacity.
* Analyse capacity and performance reports and recommend improvements to network quality and operational efficiency.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Support and mentor Network Operations Centre teams through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, NOC, Security, Core, IPBB, Change Management, MIM and CSB teams.
* Support the implementation of network changes, upgrades and new technology deployments.
* Interface with technology vendors to resolve hardware and software issues through effective escalation management.
* Ensure compliance with security, governance and operational standards.
* Participate in change management activities and support risk mitigation during deployments.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation of operational processes and documentation.
* Maintain accurate network documentation, including diagrams, configurations and operating procedures.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Experience supporting and managing large-scale enterprise network infrastructures.
* Strong technical expertise in routing, switching, wireless networking and data centre technologies.
* Hands-on knowledge of Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus, Cisco ASR, Cisco ACI, Cisco Catalyst Center and Wireless LAN technologies.
* Strong understanding of network protocols including VRF, BGP, OSPF and EIGRP.
* Experience with VSS switching environments and enterprise wireless solutions.
* Familiarity with network monitoring and diagnostic tools such as SolarWinds, NetFlow and Wireshark.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage high-severity incidents and perform effectively in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Experience working with cross-functional technical teams and external vendors.
* Understanding of network security and operational compliance requirements.
* Exposure to automation and scripting technologies such as Python and Ansible would be advantageous.
* Customer-focused mindset with a strong commitment to improving service delivery and reducing MTTR.
* Professional networking certification such as CCNP.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to work on complex enterprise and service provider-scale network environments.
* Exposure to advanced Cisco technologies including ACI, Nexus, Catalyst Centre and next-generation Wi-Fi platforms.
* Collaboration with architecture, engineering, security and operational excellence teams across the organisation.
* Involvement in major transformation, optimisation and automation initiatives.
* Opportunity to influence operational standards, incident management and continuous improvement activities.
* Access to a global technology environment supporting business-critical services.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced network operations and incident management practices.
* Enterprise-scale troubleshooting methodologies across routing, switching, wireless and data centre technologies.
* Network automation and operational efficiency techniques using Python and Ansible.
* Vendor management and technical escalation best practices.
* Change management and risk mitigation within complex technology environments.
* Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management within a global telecommunications organisation.
* Continuous improvement and operational excellence methodologies.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

OpenGov is seeking a Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering to lead our enterprise systems engineering function in Pune - a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of complex integrations with people leadership. You'll remain deeply technical, designing and owning integrations across our enterprise application stack (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce via API) alongside your team, while managing, coaching, and growing the systems engineers who build them. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in shaping technology decisions.

Based in Pune, working closely with US and India-based teams across time zones.

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Remain hands-on in the design, build, and ownership of complex integrations across enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and Salesforce using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of enterprise systems engineers, owning performance management, career growth, and hiring
* Lead project planning and execution across enterprise systems integration initiatives, ensuring on-time delivery and clear stakeholder communication
* Partner with stakeholders across R&D, GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to prioritize the roadmap and align it to business needs
* Serve as a key voice - alongside Enterprise technology leadership - in shaping technology decisions, integration patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Establish and improve team processes, documentation standards, and operational rigor to support long-term platform stability
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues
* Facilitate agile ceremonies for the team, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to keep delivery predictable and visible

**Position Qualifications**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 8+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience
* Experience managing or leading technical teams, including performance management and career development
* Demonstrated experience building integrations using REST, GraphQL, and/or SOAP APIs across different systems, with strong understanding or functional knowledge of scripting languages such as Python
* Hands-on experience with one or more of: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce
* Strong project management skills, with experience planning and delivering cross-functional technical initiatives
* Strong understanding of IAM concepts and access governance across SaaS platforms
* Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* BA/BS in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred:**

* Experience with iPaaS/automation platforms (Workato or similar)
* Experience managing a distributed team across US and India time zones
* Experience facilitating Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
* Working understanding of serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda or equivalent

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Team Lead - Software Technology
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As a Team Lead - Software Technology, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for teams designing, developing, testing, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions. You will guide architecture and engineering practices, mentor software engineers, and drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, including agentic AI and Microsoft Copilot capabilities. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work on a hybrid schedule in Pune/Noida, India.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, and support.

* Lead architectural and technical design discussions to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable enterprise software solutions.

* Drive practical adoption of AI-assisted software engineering, including Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI solutions, to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.

* Identify, prototype, and scale AI use cases using Python, APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous or multi-agent workflow patterns while applying appropriate security, privacy, human oversight, and responsible AI controls.

* Guide Agile execution through PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, task breakdown, effort estimation, risk identification, and delivery commitments.

* Review requirements, technical designs, code, test cases, and user documentation to ensure adherence to engineering standards and quality practices.

* Mentor engineers on modern software practices and effective, responsible use of AI coding assistants and automation tools.

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, Engineering Managers, QA, UX, DevOps, data, AI, and global development teams to achieve product and program objectives.

* Lead troubleshooting, debugging, integration, and resolution of complex technical issues across systems and subsystems.

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

* 10+ years of experience in software development, software design, and enterprise application development.

* 3+ years of experience in a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or comparable technical leadership role.

* 5+ years of experience conducting design reviews, code reviews, and technical assessments.

* Mandatory hands-on Python experience for automation, data processing, API integration, prototyping, or AI-enabled application development.

* Mandatory practical experience using enterprise generative AI and coding-assistant tools such as Microsoft Copilot or GitHub Copilot in software engineering workflows.

* Demonstrated understanding of agentic AI concepts, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, and safe deployment of AI agents.

* Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings or vector search, and integration of AI services through APIs.

* Ability to apply responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, intellectual-property, and model-risk controls when using AI-generated code or AI-enabled solutions.

* Strong experience in software architecture, object-oriented design, system integration, debugging, and enterprise application development.

* Experience leading Agile software development teams and participating in SAFe or a similar scaled Agile framework.

* The ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Experience designing or implementing agentic or multi-agent solutions using frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain, or AutoGen.

* Experience building AI-enabled applications on Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, or related data and AI services.

* Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, guardrails, observability, cost controls, and adoption metrics for enterprise use cases.

* Strong expertise in Java, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and enterprise application design patterns.

* Experience with modern UI/UX technologies and enterprise user interface development.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, containerization, virtualization, and modern software delivery approaches.

* Knowledge of test automation strategies and development practices such as TDD and BDD.

* Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, MES, or consumer products industries.

* Demonstrated success influencing technical direction, driving engineering excellence, and developing high-performing engineering teams.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes ...

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.

* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

* Company volunteer and donation matching program.

* Employee Assistance Program.

* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program.

* On-demand digital course library for professional development.

... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right person for this or another role.*

title: Lead Engineer
description:

We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

**Polyglot Full Stack Developer (Lead) Experience**

***Pune, India (GCC) — on-site / hybrid as applicable***

*8–10 years Team Leadership*

*Must have led a team of 5–6 developers Employment Type*

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, versatile Full Stack Developer to lead a small engineering team and drive delivery across multiple technology stacks. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing production code, architecting systems, and mentoring a team — and who thrives on picking up new tools and technologies as project needs evolve, rather than sticking to a single fixed stack.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications spanning backend services, frontend interfaces, and data layers.

* Lead and mentor a team of 5–6 developers — assigning work, conducting code reviews, unblocking issues, and owning delivery quality and timelines.

* Own system design and architecture decisions for new features and services, balancing scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.

* Build and maintain backend services in Java and Python, and frontend applications using React JS.

* Apply AI/ML concepts and tools where relevant to enhance product features or internal tooling.

* Containerize applications with Docker and support deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP).

* Design efficient, well-structured SQL schemas and queries; optimize database performance.

* Drive engineering best practices: Git workflows, code review standards, CI/CD, testing, and documentation.

* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.

* Evaluate and rapidly adopt new tools, frameworks, or languages as project requirements demand.

* Participate in technical planning, estimation, and risk identification for projects across the portfolio.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall software development experience, with demonstrated full stack delivery.

* Proven experience leading a team of 5–6 developers, including mentoring, code review, and delivery ownership.

* Strong hands-on expertise in Java for backend development.

* Strong hands-on expertise in React JS for frontend development.

* Working proficiency in Python.

* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, tools, or frameworks (e.g., applied ML, LLM integration, or data science fundamentals).

* Practical experience with Docker for containerization.

* Solid working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

* Strong SQL skills — schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.

* Demonstrated ability to design scalable, maintainable systems (system design fundamentals: caching, load balancing, microservices, API design, etc.).

* Proficiency with Git and standard branching/collaboration workflows.

* Expert, daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review.

* A polyglot mindset — genuine willingness and ability to pick up new technologies, languages, or frameworks as project requirements dictate.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

* Experience working in a distributed or GCC (Global Capability Center) setup supporting multiple business units or product lines.

* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices.

* Prior experience modernizing or rebuilding legacy platforms.

**What We're Looking For**

Beyond the technical checklist, we want someone who is curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating across ambiguity — a developer-leader who can go deep on any layer of the stack, guide a small team effectively, and is energized rather than daunted by switching technologies when a project calls for it.

*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.*

### **Why Join Us?**

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

* **Health and Wellness:**
  + Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
* **Retirement Savings:**
  + 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.

* **Paid Time Off:**
  + Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
* **Parental Leave:**
  + 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
* **Remote Work Support:**
  + Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
* **Holidays:**

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

title: Senior Manager, IT Service Operations
description:
This role leads the operating practices that keep DDN's IT services dependable as the company grows. Based in Pune, the Senior Manager owns incident, change, problem, and major incident management; establishes usable service and configuration data; and works closely with infrastructure monitoring teams. The position also provides on-site leadership in India and operational coordination across APAC and EMEA, while functional reporting relationships remain with the respective team leaders.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Service management**
----------------------

* Run and improve incident, major incident, change and problem management across IT, with clear ownership, escalation paths, communications and service restoration practices.
* Lead critical incident response, coordinate resolver teams, document timelines and follow through on root causes and corrective actions.
* Establish practical change assessment and approval controls, emergency change handling, post-implementation review, and meaningful service performance reporting.
* Maintain knowledge, procedures, and auditable evidence for service operations; partner with Security and Compliance on SOC 2 and ISO 27001 readiness.
* Act as a Change and Problem Manager for IT changes.

**Configuration data, monitoring, and employee lifecycle**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Own the service-management side of the CMDB, including data quality, ownership, relationships, and a prioritized approach to critical-service visibility.
* Partner with Core Infrastructure on monitoring and event integrations, turning alerts into actionable incidents and reducing noise and repeat outages.
* Own the operational process for employee onboarding, moves, and offboarding, coordinating HR, IAM, endpoint, and the ESM platform team; ensure ownership, approvals, and handoffs are defined.
* Work with the ESM engineers to translate process requirements into workflows, SLAs, dashboards, and control evidence.

**Regional leadership**
-----------------------

* Provide local IT leadership for the Pune site and coordinate regional operating issues across APAC and EMEA without replacing existing functional line management.
* Coach distributed IT staff on service practices, escalation discipline, documentation, and employee communication.
* Use service metrics, trends, and employee feedback to focus improvements on the issues creating the most disruption.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in IT operations or service management, including 4+ years leading technical service operations or ITSM functions.
* Hands-on command of incident, major incident, change, and problem practices, preferably in a global support environment.

description:

--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Dynatrace Observability Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in implementing, configuring, operating and optimising Dynatrace across complex enterprise environments. You will work across modern observability, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, cloud and on-premises monitoring, translating telemetry into actionable insights that improve application availability, performance, reliability and end-user experience.

The role involves close collaboration with Application, Infrastructure, Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE and Operations teams to establish proactive observability across business-critical services.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Deploy, configure, manage and troubleshoot **Dynatrace OneAgent, ActiveGate, Dynatrace Operator and DynaKube**, and onboard applications, infrastructure, middleware, Kubernetes workloads and cloud services. Configure and manage **Real User Monitoring (RUM)**, analyse user journeys and Core Web Vitals including LCP, INP and CLS, and resolve instrumentation and communication issues.
* Configure browser and HTTP **Synthetic Monitoring** for critical applications, APIs and business journeys across public and private Synthetic locations. Use **APM, PurePath, Service Flow and distributed tracing** to analyse application dependencies, failures, exceptions and performance bottlenecks.
* Deploy and operate Dynatrace within **Kubernetes** environments, monitoring clusters, nodes, namespaces, workloads, pods, containers and services. Support observability across **cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments**, including AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Correlate **metrics, logs, traces, events and business telemetry**, applying observability approaches such as RED and USE to improve root-cause analysis.
* Implement and troubleshoot **OpenTelemetry**, including the OpenTelemetry Collector, OTLP, telemetry pipelines, resource attributes, context propagation and Dynatrace integration. Define and monitor **SLIs, SLOs and error budgets**, supporting proactive reliability improvements and incident, problem and performance management.
* Configure actionable alerting, anomaly detection and notifications while reducing unnecessary alert noise and supporting enterprise incident-management processes. Build operational and management dashboards using **Dynatrace Query Language (DQL)** for application, infrastructure, Kubernetes, user experience, SLI/SLO and incident insights.
* Use **Dynatrace APIs** and integrations such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty and webhooks to support automation and operational workflows. Provide Dynatrace expertise during production incidents, major incidents and performance investigations, identifying root causes across applications, middleware, Kubernetes, infrastructure, databases, networks and external dependencies.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You bring **7+ years of overall IT experience**, ideally across application, infrastructure, middleware, DevOps, SRE or observability domains, with **3+ years of strong hands-on Dynatrace experience** in enterprise environments. You have practical experience with **OneAgent, ActiveGate, Dynatrace Operator, DynaKube and Kubernetes observability**.
* You understand **RUM, Synthetic Monitoring, APM, infrastructure monitoring, PurePath, Service Flow and distributed tracing**. You understand **OpenTelemetry, OpenTelemetry Collector, logs, metrics and traces**, together with SRE concepts including SLIs, SLOs and error budgets.
* You have Linux troubleshooting capability and understand networking fundamentals including **DNS, proxies, firewalls, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS and application connectivity**. Advanced DQL, Dynatrace APIs and automation, OpenTelemetry SDK/instrumentation, Java/JVM observability, ServiceNow integration and CI/CD knowledge would be advantageous.
* Experience with middleware including **Oracle WebLogic, Tomcat, Apache HTTP Server or IIS**, and cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure or OCI**, would be beneficial. Relevant Dynatrace certifications would also be an advantage. You can deploy and configure Dynatrace, troubleshoot instrumentation, analyse telemetry, identify root causes and translate technical telemetry into actionable insights for Application, Operations and SRE teams.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

This role offers the opportunity to work with enterprise-scale Dynatrace environments across applications, infrastructure, Kubernetes, cloud and traditional data-centre technologies. You will contribute to production reliability and observability maturity while collaborating with Application, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, SRE and Operations teams.

You will also gain exposure to advanced observability practices involving OpenTelemetry, automation, SLI/SLO management, distributed tracing, DQL and complex production troubleshooting.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

The scope of this role provides opportunities to deepen capabilities in:

* Enterprise-scale **Dynatrace architecture and platform management**.
* **Kubernetes and cloud-native observability** using Dynatrace Operator and DynaKube.
* **OpenTelemetry architecture**, including Collector pipelines, OTLP and telemetry instrumentation.
* **SRE practices**, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and service reliability.
* **DQL, dashboards, Dynatrace APIs, automation and enterprise integrations**.

Advanced production troubleshooting and end-to-end root-cause analysis across complex application and infrastructure environments.

The Threat Management Lead will be responsible for strengthening the organization's cybersecurity threat detection and response capabilities through proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, and

threat intelligence analysis. The role will lead initiatives to identify emerging cyber threats, develop and optimize security detection mechanisms, and improve visibility across the organization's IT infrastructure, applications,and cloud environments.

  
  

The individual will leverage internal security telemetry, external threat intelligence feeds, and industry threat-sharing communities to identify potential attack patterns, develop actionable detection strategies,

and proactively uncover adversarial activities that may bypass conventional security controls.

  
  
  

The role requires prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, along with strong expertise in threat detection, security monitoring, incident investigation, and threat hunting.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Detection Engineering**

* Design, develop, implement, and continuously fine-tune custom threat detection rules and use cases.
* Map detection capabilities and security monitoring coverage against the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Identify detection gaps across endpoints, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise environments.
* Develop and optimize SIEM detection rules,correlation logic, behavioral analytics, and automated alerts.
* Collaborate with SOC and incident response teams to improve detection accuracy and minimize false positives.
* Develop and enhance threat detection use cases to identify unauthorized access, suspicious activity, data exfiltration, and potential compromise involving sensitive healthcare information and patient data.
* Design and optimize security monitoring mechanisms to detect anomalous access patterns, potential data breaches, and threats targeting systems that store, process, or transmit Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).
  

  

**Threat Intelligence Management**

* Collect, analyze, and operationalize threat intelligence from internal security telemetry, commercial intelligence feeds, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and Information Sharing and Analysis Centers (ISACs).
* Analyze emerging threat actors, attack techniques,indicators of compromise (IOCs), and adversarial tactics.
* Translate threat intelligence into actionable detection rules, threat-hunting hypotheses, and security priorities.
* Maintain awareness of evolving cyber threats,vulnerabilities, attack campaigns, and industry-specific risks.
* Establish processes for integrating threat intelligence into security monitoring and incident response operations.
  

  

**Proactive Threat Hunting**

* Lead proactive threat-hunting activities to identify suspicious behavior and advanced adversarial activities that may bypass automated security tools.
* Develop threat-hunting hypotheses based on intelligence reports, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and observed security events.
* Investigate abnormal activities across endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud environments.
* Perform advanced log analysis, event correlation, and behavioral analysis to uncover hidden threats.
* Document hunting findings and translate identified threats into improved detection mechanisms and security controls.
  

  

**SOC Operations & Incident Investigation**

* Leverage previous SOC Analyst experience to support security monitoring, alert triage, incident investigation, and threat analysis.
* Work closely with SOC analysts and incident response teams to improve threat detection and investigation processes.
* Support root cause analysis of security incidents and recommend preventive and corrective security measures.
* Improve SOC detection maturity through continuous feedback, knowledge sharing, and process optimization.
  

  

**Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical leadership and guidance to SOC analysts and threat detection engineers.
* Establish detection engineering and threat-hunting standards, methodologies, and operational metrics.
* Track detection coverage, threat-hunting effectiveness, false-positive rates, and detection gaps.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application security, and security operations teams to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.
  

  

**Mandatory Skills & Qualifications**

* 8–10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst.
* Strong experience in threat detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and proactive threat hunting.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Experience developing, implementing, and tuning custom detection rules and correlation use cases.
* Strong knowledge of endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud security monitoring.
* Experience analyzing IOCs, security logs, behavioral patterns, and threat intelligence feeds.
* Strong understanding of security incident investigation, malware behavior, attack patterns, and cyber threat landscape.
* Ability to translate threat intelligence and hunting findings into actionable detection capabilities.
* Understanding of security threats and monitoring requirements relevant to healthcare environments, including threats targeting patient information, healthcare applications, and systems containing Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).
* Knowledge of healthcare data security, patient information protection, and security monitoring requirements associated with sensitive healthcare information.
* Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, or Sentinel One.
* Knowledge of detection languages and framework such as Sigma, YARA, KQL, SPL, or EQL.
* Experience with SOAR platforms and security automation.
* Understanding of cloud security monitoring across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Relevant certifications such as GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), or equivalent.
* Experience working with commercial threat intelligence platforms and ISAC communities, HIPAA awareness
  

  

**Experience & Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* 8–10 years of relevant cybersecurity experience.
* Prior experience working in a Security Operations Center (SOC) is mandatory.
* Experience leading or mentoring technical security teams is preferred.

Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**

Advisor, Software Development

**What does a great “Technical Engineering Advisor” do?**
---------------------------------------------------------

A great Technical Engineering Advisor provides technical and people leadership for teams building scalable, secure, and reliable backend services for modern banking platforms. This role translates business objectives into technical strategy, leads architecture and delivery across distributed systems, and establishes strong engineering practices.

The Technical Engineering Advisor works closely with product, architecture, DevOps, SRE, and engineering teams to deliver Java-based microservices and event-driven solutions. The role also focuses on developing engineering talent through coaching, mentoring, structured technical reviews, and capability-building initiatives.

**What you will do:**
=====================

* Lead and manage a team of backend engineers responsible for designing, developing, and supporting critical banking platform services.
* Provide technical direction for Java, Spring Boot, and Quarkus-based microservices.
* Translate business requirements and product objectives into scalable technical architecture and delivery plans.
* Drive architecture and design decisions across distributed backend systems.
* Define event-driven architecture patterns using Kafka, including idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, backpressure, and error handling.
* Own integration strategies across REST and gRPC interfaces for internal and external systems.
* Guide database design, data modelling, performance optimisation, and migration strategies for PostgreSQL-compatible databases.
* Establish engineering standards for coding, testing, observability, security, documentation, and production readiness.
* Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and technical governance forums.
* Partner with DevOps and SRE teams to strengthen CI/CD, containerisation, infrastructure automation, and OpenShift or Kubernetes operations.
* Improve platform reliability by reducing production incidents and mean time to recovery.
* Build effective monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting practices across services.
* Own technical delivery, identify engineering risks, and ensure timely resolution of technical dependencies and blockers.
* Mentor engineering leads and individual contributors through regular coaching and technical development plans.
* Support workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance development, and succession planning for the engineering team.
* Promote reusable engineering patterns and automation to improve delivery speed, consistency, and quality.
* Collaborate with product, business, architecture, security, and operations stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Lead incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvement.

**What you will need to have:**
===============================

* Minimum 14 years of experience in software engineering, including significant experience in technical leadership and engineering team management.
* Strong hands-on technical foundation in Java and Spring Boot-based microservices.
* Proven experience designing and delivering distributed, scalable, and production-grade backend systems.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, API design, and system integration.
* Hands-on expertise in Kafka and resilient event-driven architecture patterns.
* Strong experience designing and integrating REST APIs.
* Deep understanding of SQL, relational database design, performance tuning, and schema migration.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or other PostgreSQL-compatible databases.
* Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift.
* Experience establishing CI/CD, automated testing, observability, secure coding, and production-readiness standards.
* Strong understanding of unit, integration, API, contract, regression, and behavioural testing strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture discussions and make technical decisions across multiple systems or engineering teams.
* Proven experience mentoring engineers, developing technical leaders, and building high-performing teams.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to communicate technical decisions, risks, and trade-offs to business and technology leaders.
* Experience managing engineering delivery, technical dependencies, production risks, and incident resolution.
* Ability to balance people management, technical leadership, architecture, and delivery responsibilities.

**What would be great to have:**
================================

* Experience with Quarkus and Apache Camel.
* Practical exposure to gRPC-based service communication.
* Experience within banking, payments, financial services, or another regulated industry.
* Knowledge of distributed SQL platforms and advanced database migration practices.
* Experience with Liquibase or equivalent database migration tools.
* Experience with quality and security tools such as SonarQube, SpotBugs, PMD, and Fortify.
* Knowledge of BDD frameworks such as Cucumber and container-based testing using Testcontainers.
* Experience implementing enterprise-level observability, including metrics, distributed tracing, logging, and alerting.
* Experience leading large-scale platform modernisation or cloud-native transformation programmes.
* Understanding of security, compliance, resiliency, and audit requirements within regulated technology environments.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Lead Data Architecture
description:
**About Advanced Energy**

  

Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: AEIS), enables design breakthroughs and drives growth for leading semiconductor and industrial customers. Our precision power and control technologies, along with our applications know-how, inspire close partnerships and innovation in thin-film and industrial manufacturing. We are proud of our rich heritage, award-winning technologies, and we value the talents and contributions of all Advanced Energy's employees worldwide.

  

**Role Summary**

  

We are looking for a highly skilled Lead Data Architecture with deep expertise and own the direction, standards of AEI’s enterprise data architecture and ensure the health of Data architecture and the creation and updating of key Data Architecture deliverables

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**

  

* Create AEI's Data Architecture vision covering all Data & Analytics components, enterprise-wide baseline and target data architectures, including architectures that enable BI, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled data products.
* Support in Data & Analytics solutions and product development as Data architect in terms of Data architecture, standards, best practices, assets and frameworks, ensuring data products are reusable across operational reporting, analytics, data science, and AI use cases.
* Responsible for the design and implementation of AEI’s enterprise data architecture, ensuring current and future business data and analytical needs, including advanced analytics and AI consumption patterns, are supported.
* Be the custodian of enterprise-wide data lineage from source to target and able to deep dive vertically when required.
* Develop holistic roadmap of Data architecture change initiatives across AEI, lead from the front to consolidate data requirements across different initiatives.
* Mentor and provide technical oversight to Data Solution Architects, Data Engineers in creating data products to Business adhering to the data architecture and governance standards
* Plan for team capability growth considering the skills required within the data architecture team and to assist in resourcing decisions
* Key stakeholder and advisor in all new strategic data and analytics initiatives and ensure alignment to the enterprise data strategy
* Drive consistent data standards and approaches, building an environment that encourages continuous improvement and innovation, including the appropriate use of AI to improve data engineering, data quality, metadata management, data discovery, and analytics workflows.
* Responsible for the definition and development of data architecture principles, guidelines, data services, analytical tools, standards, and frameworks required to support AEI Data architecture.
* Define Data migration strategy and device implementation approach
* Provide Data Architecture expertise for Projects Delivery, working with Product Mangers and solution architects.
* Work with Enterprise Application teams, stakeholders and Partners to understand target data architecture delivery dependencies and align delivery timelines.
* Provide architectural support to operations and project delivery teams.
* Lead the data solution design efforts and synergize with Data Governance processes, for analytical and AI consumptions.
* Creating templates for data architecture deliverables and artifacts for Projects and supporting data solution architects to complete
* Evaluate new trends, architect, and deploy new tools, frameworks, and patterns to build sustainable Big Data and Cloud platforms.
* Accountable for defining key indicators of the performance of the Data Architecture
* Accountable for assuring the alignment of data architecture to the target by decision and coordination among cross projects and enterprise
  

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.·
* 12+ years of overall experience in similar roles
* TOGAF Certified or equivalent
* Deep understanding of the Data architecture discipline, processes, concepts and best practices, that support BI, advanced analytics, machine learning and AI workloads
* Data Solutions Design and Data Integration experience across enterprise platforms, including batch, streaming, API-based, and modern cloud data integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of Data Governance, Security, Privacy and Compliance requirements for an enterprise, including governance of data consumed by AI/ML solutions.
* Data Dictionary and Cataloguing
* Data Lake, Datawarehouse, Lakehouse Design, SQL expertise, Data Ingestion techniques
* Possess strong knowledge of industry best practices around modern data architecture in Cloud and Big Data environments
* Strong experience in Solutions Modelling, Data Modelling – Logical & Physical
* Working knowledge of modern AI-ready data architecture concepts, including embeddings, vector search, RAG, semantic search and the data requirements associated with machine learning and generative AI.
* Understanding of data preparation, feature engineering, and MLOps concepts and how enterprise data platforms enable predictive analytics, machine learning, optimization, forecasting, and other advanced analytics use cases.
* Analytical, Structured thinker, Effective Leadership and Communication
* Background in ERP, Manufacturing, Engineering and Supply Chain is preferable.
* Experience with modern analytics and AI capabilities within platforms such as Azure, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric.
  

**Work Environment:**

  

* Works in a standard office environment utilizing standard office equipment.
* Location: Pune, India
* Works in team and individual environments.
* Ability to work on projects with global team members outside of standard office hours.
* May work weekends and overtime when necessary.
* Ability to travel as needed, both domestic and international

title: Sr. Databricks Platform Admin
description:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full-time

### **Job Details**

**Role summary**
----------------

  
  
  

We are hiring a Senior Databricks Platform Administrator to own the Azure Databricks platform behind Associa's Data Lake.

You will run the workspaces, Unity Catalog, identity, networking and infrastructure as code that our data engineers, analysts and data scientists build on. You will be the team's authority on Terraform, Azure and Entra ID authentication for Databricks, accountable for a secure, governed, reliable and cost-controlled platform.

  
  

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

  

**Terraform:** own the Terraform codebases for Azure infrastructure and Databricks configuration, including modules, remote state, provider upgrades, drift and imports. Keep every platform change in code and review the team's Terraform pull requests.

  

**Azure:** manage VNet-injected workspaces, private endpoints and DNS, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, managed identities and Azure RBAC.

  
  

**Identity and authentication:** own the Entra ID integration with Databricks: SCIM sync, groups, entitlements, service principals, OAuth and OIDC workload identity federation. Keep access least-privilege.

  
  

**Unity Catalog:** administer the metastore, catalogs, external locations, storage credentials, grants and Delta Sharing as code.

  

**Compute:** own cluster policies, SQL warehouses, serverless settings and runtime upgrades, and keep usage and cost under control.

  

**CI/CD:** own the Azure DevOps pipelines for Terraform and Databricks Asset Bundles, including service connections, environments and approvals.

  

**Operations:** configure audit logging and system tables, act as escalation point for platform incidents and Databricks support, plan for Databricks platform changes, and document the platform.

  
  

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

  

10+ years in cloud infrastructure or platform engineering, with hands-on Azure Databricks administration.

  

Expert Terraform: modules, remote state, imports, provider upgrades, and plan/apply through CI/CD with the azurerm, azuread and databricks providers.

  

Deep Azure knowledge: VNet injection, Private Link and DNS, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, managed identities and RBAC.

  
  

Strong Entra ID and authentication expertise: SCIM, service principals, OAuth, OIDC and workload identity federation.

  

Unity Catalog and Databricks account and workspace administration.

  

Azure DevOps YAML pipelines.

  

Scripting in PowerShell, Bash or Python, and comfort with the Databricks CLI and REST APIs.

  
  

**Nice to have**
----------------

  

Databricks Platform Administrator certification, or Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-305 or AZ-500.

HashiCorp Terraform certification.

  
  

Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles, Delta Sharing, Apps or model serving.

  

Data engineering knowledge (Spark, Delta Lake, Lakeflow jobs and pipelines), enough to support the engineers who build on the platform.

title: Project Sr Lead - C14 - PUNE
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Team Overview**

The Markets Operations Process Engineering Team drives transformational change within Operations’ processes and functions through the combination of data analysis and optimum process design.

We partner closely with our Operations teams to design and deliver Target Operating Models (TOM) through automation, leveraging both Low-Code Solutions and Core Technology platforms. Our goal is to deliver best-in-class process engineering solutions to enable our Operations professionals to excel with client service excellence, robust risk management, and continuous improvement.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a high-performing Senior Vice President (SVP)to lead and drive a strategic portfolio of transformational initiatives across Futures & Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Process Engineering.

In this role, you will act as a senior program delivery lead and transformation partner, architecting modern Target Operating Models, driving end-to-end process re-engineering, and delivering scalable automation solutions. You will combine deep domain understanding of trade life cycles and clearing workflows with seasoned program management rigor to deliver tangible efficiency, risk mitigation, and capacity gains.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program & Portfolio Leadership**

* Portfolio Strategy & Execution: Own end-to-end governance and delivery of the transformation portfolio across FDC and/or Equities Operations, ensuring alignment with global strategic business priorities.
* Program Governance: Establish and maintain program structure, milestones, KPIs, resource allocation, budget oversight, and transparent executive status reporting.
* Benefits Realization: Define, track, and validate quantitative and qualitative business outcomes (e.g., FTE capacity creation, error rate reduction, STP rate improvements, risk reduction).
* Dependency & Risk Management: Proactively identify, track, and remediate cross-functional dependencies, delivery bottlenecks, and project risks.

**Process Engineering & Operating Model Design**

* Target Operating Model (TOM): Design, define, and implement future-state operating models across post-trade processing, clearing, allocation, reconciliation, and settlement workflows.
* Process Diagnostic & Mapping: Lead detailed process discovery, value stream mapping, and root-cause analyses using Lean/Six Sigma frameworks to eliminate waste and non-value-added steps.
* Data-Driven Analysis: Leverage operational data, trade metrics, and exception patterns to build compelling business cases and prioritize process re-engineering pipelines.
* Solution Architecture & Delivery: Partner with Core Technology and Architecture teams to translate business requirements into scalable, resilient system enhancements and platform upgrades.
* Implementation & Change Management: Oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), operational readiness rehearsals, cutover planning, and post-implementation checkouts

**Stakeholder Engagement & Risk Governance**

* Executive Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong consultative partnerships with senior Operations Desk Heads, Business Heads, Technology Leaders, Product Managers, and Compliance Partners.
* Operational Resilience: Embed robust controls, auditability, and business continuity measures into every deployed process solution.

**Team Leadership & Culture**

* Talent Development: Lead, mentor, and upskill a team of process engineers, business analysts, and project managers, cultivating high-performance delivery standards.
* Continuous Improvement Culture: Champion an agile, innovation-led mindset across the wider Markets Operations organization.

**Skills & Experience**

* Proven track record (10+ years) leading complex, large-scale change management and process transformation programs within Tier 1 Investment Banks or Financial Institutions.
* In-depth operational domain knowledge across Futures & Derivatives Clearing (FDC) (exchange-traded derivatives, cleared OTC derivatives, margin/collateral, client clearing) and/or Equities Operations (cash equities, equity derivatives, corporate actions, trade booking, allocations, settlements).
* Strong working knowledge of global market structure, clearing houses (CCPs), industry utilities (e.g., DTCC, Euroclear, Traiana, MarkitWire), and relevant regulatory frameworks (e.g., CFTC, SEC, EMIR, MiFID II).
* Extensive expertise leading Target Operating Model (TOM) design and end-to-end process re-engineering.
* Deep proficiency in program management delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, Hybrid)
* Strong data analytics and literacy skills, with experience utilizing operational datasets and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to drive decision-making and measure benefits realization.
* Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with proven ability to influence, negotiate, and partner effectively with C-suite and senior business, operations, and technology leaders.
* Strong strategic problem-solving and root-cause analysis capabilities, with a pragmatic approach to resolving operational, technical, and architectural bottlenecks.
* Proven leadership and people management experience, with a track record of developing high-performing, multi-disciplinary, and globally distributed teams.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.

* Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric services.
* Strong understanding of Delta Lake architecture, data storage optimization, and transaction management.
* Experience implementing Medallion Architecture and modern data engineering patterns.
* Strong data modeling skills for analytical, dimensional, and reporting workloads.

* Experience monitoring and troubleshooting Spark jobs, pipelines, SQL workloads, and platform performance issues.
* Strong understanding of data quality, validation, reconciliation, and operational support processes.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in Agile development environments and collaborate with globally distributed teams.

description:

---------------

You don't have an AI story if you don't have your data story. That's where NexusOne comes in.

We're the converged data platform for the AI era — composable by design, built on an open-source foundation, and AI-native from the ground up. One identity, one governance envelope, one operational layer across every mainframe, data lake, warehouse, and streaming system in the business. For the first time, enterprises can bring their existing stack along instead of rebuilding it — and still give AI agents full context across the estate.

What we stand for is simple: sovereign data, interoperable systems, decoupled intelligence — delivered the way modern software should be. No rip-and-replace. No multi-year transformation. Our CEO Anu Jain puts it well: we turn the "ball of yarn" of data integrations into a unified engine — less like assembling car parts, more like buying the car ready to drive. 85+ open-source tools pre-integrated. AI-native automations that deploy and self-heal the stack without human toil. Forward-deployed engineers who build shoulder-to-shoulder with customer teams — hands on keyboards, not just on decks.

It's working, and fast. We're tripling revenue year over year, backed by Insight Partners, and running in production in environments most vendors won't touch. Our platform processes credit risk data for 90%+ of US small businesses — 40M+ — every month. Intent signals for 300M+ subscribers monthly for Africa's largest telco. The data and AI layer for a Top 3 US bank.

We're 100+ people across the US and India, headquartered in Atlanta. We think big, move fast, and don't mistake activity for progress. We hire people who'd rather ship the rocket than brief someone on it.

Check out this podcast of Anu talking about our solution here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g8g50sv5GhQ

**General expectation:**

* Experience integrating Azure Active Directory with FreeIPA and other directory services such as LDAP, enhancing security and user management.
* Up-to-date knowledge of the Hadoop Big Data ecosystem, staying current with the latest technologies and best practices.

title: Senior Embedded Test Engineer
description:
**Job Summary** :

At Emerson, we help the world run safer and smarter. As a global leader in automation, our Analytical Instruments organization develops advanced technologies and solutions that safeguard industries and keep critical systems running.

Join our Liquid Analysis team in Pune, India, as an Embedded Software Test Engineer - where you'll work on testing new and legacy products for process analytical equipment that protects water quality, supports life sciences, strengthens industrial safety, and serves industries worldwide.

If you enjoy software, automation, and understanding how complex systems really behave, this is an opportunity to help build the test capabilities behind our next generation of products and work side-by-side with development to engineer quality into the product from the beginning - become part of a team that’s growing, learning, and focused on delivering results!

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test systems, frameworks, and tools for embedded products and software.
* Develop automated integration, system, regression, and verification tests, while supporting hands-on manual testing when needed.
* Partner with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to build alignment, clarify requirements and risks, and develop effective test solutions with meaningful test coverage.
* Build test capabilities for embedded communications, networking, hardware interfaces, and complex system behaviors.
* Troubleshoot product and test-system failures using debugging, instrumentation, logs, data analysis, and root-cause analysis.
* Follow and help strengthen established test engineering practices aligned with our SDLA and IEC 62443-4-1, including requirements traceability, reviews, documentation, cybersecurity testing, and objective test evidence.
* Contribute to the test strategy and breakdown of verification work, helping define what to test, how to test it, and how testing can be automated effectively.
* Explore and apply AI, automation technologies, and engineering tools to improve test coverage, efficiency, maintainability, and problem solving.

**Who You Are:**

You take on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks.

You deal constructively with problems that do not have clear solutions or outcomes.

You grow from hardships and negative experiences

You partner with others to get work done.

You admit mistakes and gain insight from experiences.

Korn Ferry Competencies: Nimble Learning, Manages Ambiguity, Being Resilient, Collaborates, Demonstrates Self-awareness

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science from an engineering school required.
* Minimum of six (6) years of applicable experience

**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**

* Strong programming skills in Python and C#, with experience building maintainable test automation software.
* Hands-on experience developing automated test frameworks, tools, and reusable test libraries for embedded products.
* Experience testing embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware/software interfaces, and real-time systems.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD or continuous integration environments.
* Experience with Ethernet/TCP-IP, serial interfaces, and industrial communication protocols.
* Experience with requirements-based verification, traceability, and secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Experience designing or integrating test fixtures, instrumentation, data acquisition, or hardware-in-the-loop test systems.
* Experience leading test automation or verification efforts, including developing test strategies and breaking complex verification work into executable test activities.
* Experience applying AI-assisted engineering tools to test development, test generation, failure analysis, or engineering productivity.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and technical communication skills.

**Why Join Our Team?**

We're building the next generation of Liquid Analysis products around a highly visible program with significant market potential. It's real embedded engineering across software, electronics, sensors, communications, automation, cybersecurity, and test. We're also growing the software team around it, so people joining now can influence not only the products, but architecture, automation, engineering practices, AI, and how the team works.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**

**Clarity Quality Speed.** We want curious people who jump in, learn fast, communicate openly, ask questions, challenge constructively, work through disagreements, and then align and move. Development and test are partners, and quality belongs to the whole engineering team.

At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers. This philosophy is fundamental to living our company’s values and our responsibility to leave the world in a better place. Learn more about our Culture & Values and about Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Emerson. IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. The mission of the Data Engineer is to design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and warehouse models that turn complex life science and healthcare data into clean, trusted datasets that power analytics and decision-making.

**What you’ll do to thrive in this role:**

* Develop scalable, reliable, and efficient data pipelines using dbt, Python, or other ELT tools
* Design, implement, and maintain scalable data orchestration and transformation processes, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and timeliness
* Build and maintain scalable, complex dbt models
* Develop data warehouse structures, including dimension and fact tables
* Implement Type 1 and Type 2 slowly changing dimensions (SCDs) to accurately capture historical and current data
* Manage and execute data mart updates to support downstream reporting and analytics
* Build conformed dimensions through integration with Master Data Management (MDM) systems
* Work with life science and healthcare datasets, applying domain knowledge to ensure data quality and relevance
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Partner closely with data analysts and data scientists to deliver clean, well-structured datasets for analysis and modeling
* Collaborate with fellow engineers across Git repositories, following sound version control and code review practices

  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech or B.E.) in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline and/or equivalent practical experience
* Advanced SQL skills, including writing, optimizing, and troubleshooting complex queries across large datasets
* Strong expertise in data warehouse development and concepts, including dimensional modeling, Type 1/Type 2 SCDs, data mart updates, and conformed dimensions via MDM integration
* Hands-on proficiency with ETL tools such as dbt, Python, SSIS, or PowerCenter
* Proven ability to design and build ETL/ELT pipelines that are reliable, scalable, and easy to maintain
* Demonstrated experience working with Git and collaborating with other engineers across repositories
* Availability to work with meaningful overlap with US Eastern business hours
* Experience working with life science or healthcare data and an understanding of its quality and compliance considerations
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS
* Practical experience building and optimizing workloads in Snowflake, preferred
* Practical experience building and maintaining complex dbt models, including testing and documentation, preferred
* Snowflake or dbt certification, preferred
