title: Security Delivery Lead
description:
Security Delivery Lead – Security Operations (SecOps)

**Experience:** 12+ Years  
**Role:** Security Delivery Lead  
**Domain:** Security Operations (SecOps)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contract  
**Work Model:** As per Client Requirement  
**Shift:** 24x7 Operations Management

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Security Delivery Lead** to own and manage end-to-end delivery of 24x7 L1 and L2 Security Operations (SecOps) services in an Infrastructure Managed Services (IMS/MSP) environment.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience managing multi-tower security operations, including Network Security (NetSec), Identity and Access Management (IDAM), Malware/Endpoint Security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and SecOps Command Center operations.

The candidate will be responsible for service delivery, SLA/KPI management, client governance, major incident management (MIM), escalations, commercial management, invoicing, resource planning, contractual reviews, and continuous service improvement.

Key Responsibilities1. Service Delivery Management

* Own end-to-end delivery of L1 and L2 security operations across multiple security towers.
* Lead SecOps Command Center (L1) and NetSec, IDAM, Malware Tools, and DLP teams.
* Act as the single point of contact for client security leadership.
* Conduct daily operational meetings and weekly service reviews.
* Drive service improvement initiatives and ensure timely closure of action items.

2. SLA, Reporting & Governance

* Monitor and manage response and resolution SLAs across all security towers.
* Prepare and publish weekly/monthly SLA, KPI, backlog, and service performance reports.
* Present service performance during monthly and quarterly governance reviews.
* Maintain RAID logs and ensure proper ServiceNow ticket management.
* Ensure ticket hygiene, documentation, and quality of closure.

3. Incident Management & Escalations

* Participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) bridge calls for P1/P2 and security incidents.
* Own client and internal escalations through resolution.
* Coordinate with infrastructure teams, OEM vendors, and client L3 teams.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), problem management, and corrective action plans.
* Communicate security incidents, business impact, and remediation plans to stakeholders.

4. Commercial & Contract Management

* Manage monthly invoicing inputs and service reconciliation.
* Track service deliverables against SOW scope and contractual obligations.
* Manage change requests arising from scope changes.
* Lead contractual reviews, including service credits, penalties, and SLA commitments.

5. Resource & People Management

* Manage capacity planning, shift rosters, and 24x7 on-call coverage.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding, retention, and resource backfills.
* Maintain skill matrices and cross-skilling plans across security teams.
* Conduct performance reviews, coaching, and career development discussions.
* Manage onshore and offshore delivery teams.

6. Security Compliance & Risk Management

* Ensure compliance with client security policies and standards.
* Monitor firewall, endpoint agent, patching, and DLP policy compliance.
* Support internal and external audits with required evidence.
* Oversee access reviews and privileged access governance.

7. Continual Service Improvement

* Drive automation, alert tuning, and repeat-incident reduction.
* Maintain SOPs, operational runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.
* Lead transition and onboarding of new security services.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality.

Required Technical Knowledge

**Network Security:**

* Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA)
* Palo Alto Firewalls and Panorama
* Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW)
* Secure Web Gateway and Zero Trust Access

**Identity & Access Management:**

* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Active Directory
* Okta, CyberArk
* SSO, MFA, PAM
* Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes

**Endpoint & Malware Security:**

* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* CrowdStrike Falcon
* Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
* Antivirus and phishing response

**Data Protection & Email Security:**

* Microsoft Purview
* Symantec DLP
* Microsoft AIP
* Netskope
* Email encryption and data classification

**Monitoring & ITSM Tools:**

* ServiceNow (ITSM, reporting, dashboards)
* Splunk
* Datadog
* PagerDuty
* Jira and Confluence

Required Experience & Qualifications

* 12+ years of overall IT and Security Operations experience.
* 10+ years of experience in Security Service Delivery / Delivery Leadership within an Infrastructure Managed Services or MSP environment.
* Proven experience managing 24x7 multi-tower security operations for global enterprise clients.
* Experience managing onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers.
* Strong understanding of NetSec, IDAM, Endpoint Security, DLP, and SOC operations.
* Basic working knowledge of Zscaler, Palo Alto, Microsoft Purview, Email Encryption, Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike, Entra ID, CyberArk, and Workday.
* Strong experience in SLA management, invoicing, contractual reviews, and governance in an MSP model.
* Hands-on experience in Major Incident Management (MIM) and senior stakeholder escalation management.
* Excellent communication, presentation, client management, and leadership skills.

Preferred Certifications

* CISSP or CISM
* ITIL 4 Foundation
* Microsoft SC-100 / SC-200
* Zscaler or Palo Alto certifications

*Certifications are preferred but not mandatory.*

Key Skills

Security Service Delivery | SecOps | Managed Services | 24x7 Operations | L1/L2 Operations | Network Security | IDAM | DLP | Endpoint Security | SLA Management | KPI Reporting | Major Incident Management | ITIL | ServiceNow | Client Governance | Contract Management | Resource Management | RCA | Continuous Improvement

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated resumes.**

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pune, Maharashtra

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

As a Senior Data Engineer specializing in ETL and tax reporting systems, you will design and build the data pipelines that keep Citi's Corporate Tax Reporting applications accurate and reliable. Based in Pune, you will manage the flow of data from multiple upstream providers, working closely with the **Ab Initio and DataLake ETL development team** to translate business requirements into resilient technical solutions. This role gives you direct ownership of data quality standards that support regulatory tax filings across the organization.

* Design and build reliable ETL solutions that consume and process upstream data feeds for Corporate Tax Reporting applications.
* Translate business requirements and data analysis findings into detailed technical specifications for the ETL development team.
* Monitor and analyze upstream data feeds to track layout changes, system migrations, and decommissions.
* Establish automated data quality checks, validation logic, and reconciliation frameworks that ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Coordinate releases, testing cycles, and change management activities with multiple upstream application teams.
* Communicate technical solutions and the impact of data feed changes to business stakeholders supporting tax reporting.

* Proficiency in **SQL for data analysis, validation, and reconciliation.**

* A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

* Work in a hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.
* Build technical depth in enterprise-scale ETL and data quality engineering within a regulated financial environment.
* Access ongoing learning and development programs to grow your data engineering career.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

The role is focused on maintaining high service availability, resolving technically complex incidents, managing changes and improving operational performance and customer experience.

You will combine Unified Communications and telecoms knowledge, including SIP protocol expertise, with advanced Power BI and data analytics capabilities to identify performance trends, provide actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making. * Analyse complex technical issues independently and implement effective solutions that protect service availability and customer experience.
* Recommend and implement configuration changes to maintain service and network performance indicators at optimal levels.
* Use Power BI, data analytics, reporting and dashboards to monitor operational performance, identify trends and provide actionable insights for service optimisation and decision-making.
* Build sustainable working relationships with internal teams and external partners to support service-level and performance compliance.
* Provide technical guidance, delegate task-level activities where appropriate and mentor first-line support teams.

* Contribute to service optimisation, automation and cost-effective delivery, while supporting longer-term service roadmaps and operational priorities.

* You can collaborate effectively with internal teams, external partners and first-line support colleagues, with the ability to provide technical guidance and support service-level and performance commitments.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

------------------------

* An opportunity to work on business-critical Unified Communications services with direct influence on service availability and customer experience.
* Exposure to complex telecommunications and network operations across local markets.
* Opportunities to apply Power BI, dashboarding and data analytics to real operational challenges and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience contributing to service optimisation, automation and longer-term operational roadmaps.
* Opportunities to provide technical guidance and mentor first-line support colleagues.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Deeper expertise in Unified Communications operations, telecoms networks and SIP-based services.
* Advanced application of Power BI, operational reporting, dashboarding and data analytics.
* Complex incident, change and service-performance management.
* Service optimisation and automation within a telecommunications operations environment.

title: Lead Implementation Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Lead Implementation Engineer is a technical delivery person who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life across the most complex and highest-stakes deployments. This role owns the end-to-end technical strategy for large, multi-module implementations, from solution architecture and data migration design through configuration, testing, and go-live, and sets the technical quality bar for the entire Implementation Engineering organization.  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to senior government leaders, the Implementation Engineer IV combines deep product expertise with advanced data architecture, database, and automation skills. The role translates complex customer goals, legacy system constraints, and cross-departmental workflows into scalable, governed, and maintainable solutions. Beyond hands-on delivery, the Implementation Engineer IV shapes how the organization works: defining standards and reusable frameworks, coaching senior and mid-level engineers, resolving escalated technical risk, and driving the process and product improvements that make implementations faster, more consistent, and more repeatable for every customer.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the technical strategy and solution architecture for the most complex, multi-module government implementations across the United States, including large-scale data migrations, multi-system integrations, and multi-department rollouts
* Set the standard for configuration and data reviews across the implementation organization, approving final designs for high-risk deployments and ensuring alignment with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability
* Lead data architecture for customer migrations, defining source-to-target mapping strategies, ETL frameworks, reconciliation controls, and validation approaches that produce audit-ready data at scale
* Resolve critical technical blockers escalated from active implementations, performing root-cause analysis on data integrity, performance, and configuration issues and driving corrective action with Product and Engineering
* Lead requirements discovery with executive and technical stakeholders, pressure-testing assumptions, resolving conflicting departmental needs, and advising customers on design trade-offs with clear business impact
* Define comprehensive test strategies and quality gates for complex deployments, and ensure test scenarios validate that configuration, integrations, and migrated data produce accurate outcomes before go-live
* Serve as the senior technical advisor to government executives, Budget Directors, CIOs, and IT leadership, building long-term trust and guiding them through deployment, integration, and adoption strategy
* Mentor and develop Implementation Engineers across all levels, providing technical leadership, reviewing complex configuration and data work, and building the skills and career paths of the broader engineering team
* Establish and continuously improve implementation standards, playbooks, reusable tooling, and automation frameworks that raise delivery quality, consistency, and speed across the organization
* Identify systemic patterns in customer pain points and lead cross-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Data/Integration, Project Management, and Customer Success to simplify and automate workflows at scale
* Represent the voice of the customer in product and roadmap discussions, translating field insights into prioritized, well-scoped recommendations that shape the future of the platform
* Evaluate and champion emerging technologies, including AI-driven automation, to accelerate migration, validation, and implementation workflows while maintaining rigorous data governance and security standards

**Requirements and Preferred Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* 9 to 12 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, with a proven record of leading complex enterprise or SaaS deployments
* 7+ years of hands-on SQL experience, including advanced query design, performance tuning, data transformation, and reconciliation across large datasets
* 5+ years of Python or similar scripting experience for automation, data processing, and building reusable delivery tooling
* Deep expertise in database architecture and ETL and data-migration methodologies, including schema design, indexing and performance optimization, and governance of data quality at scale
* Demonstrated experience designing and leading AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, using modern frameworks and AI models
* Proven track record of owning multiple concurrent complex implementations end to end and of raising the technical capability of other engineers through mentorship, reviews, and formal knowledge sharing
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior government stakeholders, align cross-functional teams, and present technical strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous approach to validation, reconciliation, and sign-off, with a demonstrated ability to establish quality standards that others adopt
* Comfort operating with ambiguity in a rapidly changing product environment, making sound decisions under pressure, and adapting strategy as customer needs evolve
* Experience working with or within government, public sector, or regulated environments is strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
Pune, Maharashtra, India

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19532 **Date posted** 11/02/2026

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years building ML systems that work at scale, not just in notebooks but in production, where data pipelines break, training runs fail at hour 47, and someone has to own the fix. The difference between a model that ships and one that stays in research is usually the unglamorous work of versioning datasets, writing tests, and making sure the thing can actually be called from a product workflow. You are the engineer who closes that gap.

Scientific simulation data is different. Irregular 3D meshes, physics constraints that matter, and datasets where one bad simulation can poison a training run. You have worked with data like this before, or you are ready to learn why it matters. Either way, you know that the model is only as good as the data it was trained on, and you care about that upstream problem as much as the architecture.

Deployment is not someone else's job. You think about what happens after the checkpoint: how it gets packaged, how inference gets served, how a product engineer in a different timezone calls it without breaking their workflow. At Synopsys, you will build the infrastructure that makes Large Physics Foundation Models real for CFD, thermal, and electromagnetics products that customers actually ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and extend dataset factories that produce repeatable, versioned corpora across geometry, mesh, and solver setup using agentic orchestration, shared across CFD, Icepak (electronics cooling), and HFSS (high-frequency electromagnetics)
* Produce large, quality-gated datasets for training Large Physics Foundation Models, ensuring bad simulations are quarantined and data provenance is tracked end to end
* Take trained checkpoints through deployment: package models, stand up inference serving, and build integrations that product teams can call inside their workflows for initialization, prediction, or design-loop acceleration
* Partner with product teams to understand deployment constraints, test in real workflows, and support forward-deployed engineering when models go live
* Write production-grade Python with testing, versioning, CI, and operability for long-running jobs that span data generation, training, and serving
* Build data loaders and training pipelines for irregular 3D simulation data using PyTorch, handling distributed training, checkpointing, and physics-based evaluation metrics
* Own the ambiguous boundary between data engineering, model training, and product deployment, closing gaps instead of waiting for a perfect handoff

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable Synopsys simulation products to shift from "run a solver for every design" to "a model trained on high-fidelity data proposes a physically useful field in seconds," fundamentally changing how customers design cars, aircraft, chips, packages, and RF systems
* Build the data and deployment infrastructure that competitors cannot replicate from a research paper, giving Synopsys a durable advantage in physics-informed ML
* Accelerate design loops for customers by orders of magnitude, letting them explore more configurations, fail faster, and use expensive solvers only where fidelity still matters
* Create reusable dataset factories that scale across multiple physics domains, so campaigns can generate trusted multi-physics corpora without reinventing the pipeline every time
* Make Large Physics Foundation Models operationally real for product teams, so they can ship models that customers trust and that survive contact with production workflows
* Establish reproducible training runs and physics-based evaluation standards that ensure models fail gracefully and teams know the bounds of what they can and cannot predict
* Support product integrations that let downstream engineers call your models without needing to understand the ML stack, just the physics constraints that matter for their workflow

### **What You'll Need**

* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field (PhD welcome but not required)
* 2-3+ years building ML systems in production, with meaningful time spent on large scientific datasets, simulation data, HPC environments, or deploying models beyond notebooks
* Strong Python engineering habits: testing, versioning, CI/CD, API design, and operability of long-running jobs
* Hands-on deep learning experience with PyTorch or equivalent, including data loaders for irregular 3D data, distributed training, and checkpointing
* Experience with transformers, vision-language models, neural operators, geometric deep learning, graph networks, or physics surrogates is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ability to own work across ambiguous boundaries between data engineering, model training, and product deployment

### **Who You Are**

* You close gaps instead of waiting for someone else to define the interface. If the data pipeline does not exist, you build it. If the deployment story is unclear, you figure it out with the product team.
* Scientific honesty matters to you. You quarantine bad simulations, report what the model does not predict, and own the bounds of failure instead of overselling what works.
* You defer to specialists on what you do not know and collaborate effectively with product engineers who will live with your deployment long after you hand it off.
* You can explain a technical tradeoff to a product manager in two sentences without losing the nuance, and you can debug a distributed training failure at 3am when the run is 80% done.
* You think in systems, not just models. The checkpoint is not the finish line. Packaging, serving, versioning, and supportability are part of the job, and you treat them that way.

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

The team's job is to make Large Physics Foundation Models real for CFD, Icepak, and HFSS. Research defines the architectures and learning objectives. This engineering seat makes the data and the runtime real. You will work with specialists who understand the physics deeply, product teams who know what customers need, and other ML engineers who care about building systems that scale. The core mission has three parts: reuse and scale dataset factories so campaigns produce large, clean, 3D physics corpora; train large models on that data with reproducible runs and physics-based evaluation; and deploy and support those models so product teams can integrate them, operate them, and trust their limits.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Test Manager
description:

Area of Expertise: Technology

Join us as a Test Manager at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

To be successful as a Test Manager, you should have experience with:

  
  

* Proven ability to drive quality engineering practices, automation standards, code reviews, and testing governance.
* Strong grasp of software testing concepts, methodologies, test strategy, planning, defect management, and QA processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills, with a keen eye for spotting quality risks early.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration with development, business, and QA teams.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models, using test management tools such as Jira.
* Experience testing applications across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end cycles.
* Proven expertise in API and web services testing .
* Hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks for API, UI, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery processes.
* Core Java, with a focus on automation framework development and test engineering best practices.
* Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Karate, and other modern test automation tools.
* SQL for backend validation and testing.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, and GitLab to design and run every test and review the outcomes.
* Ability to mentor engineers and drive automation-first quality engineering culture across teams.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* Exposure to performance and resilience testing methodologies.
* Experience with modern test reporting, monitoring, and quality dashboards.
* Familiarity with Shift-Left testing, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices.
* Exposure to non-functional testing strategies.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune..

**Purpose of the role**

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Business Functional Analyst**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Corporate Title: AVP**

**Role Description**

* We are looking for a Business & Data Analyst to join our team in TDI – RF – Reporting Domain, to work on Strategic Data Onboarding and Supporting Strategic Data Initiatives across the new Capital program, supporting the Bank’s ambition to provide more frequent, timely and enhanced capital reporting.You will support predominately the BFA Chapter covering the Group Regulatory Reporting.

In addition, you will work with IT to specify the requirements and to ensure that they are technically integrated and implemented correctly
To fulfil this role, you will cover both, a detailed understanding of the banking products, business content and the calculation / reporting requirements as well as their conceptual and technical representation including strategic data sourcing and modelling within the corresponding technical reporting and calculation frameworks.  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Business and functional analysis for the Capital program and related Finance and regulatory transformation initiatives, supporting more regular, timely and enhanced capital reporting.
* Assess end-to-end current-state processes, data flows, controls, systems and governance, identifying gaps, risks, dependencies and opportunities for simplification or automation.
* Data Analytics (High Volume & Content Driven) - (Essential)

* Conceptual Design and Customisation of Warehouse Components

* Business Data Modelling, Business Impact Analysis and Reverse Engineering Analysis

**Your skills and experience**

* Banking Product knowledge and knowledge of Regulatory Calculations. (Advantage)

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple work streams. Proactive with a can-do attitude.

Excellent team player  



**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team

Job Title: Snowflake Data Engineer

Skills Required: Data Engineering/Snowflake

Years of Experience: 2 yrs

Number of Positions: 10

Job Description: 2. Snowflake Data Engineer Experience: 2–4 years Core skills: Snowflake, SQL, ETL/ELT, data modeling, and Python. Role Overview We are looking for a Snowflake Data Engineer with strong SQL skills and hands-on experience developing and maintaining data pipelines. The candidate will work with engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver reliable, well-structured data for reporting, analytics, and downstream applications. The role requires practical experience in data ingestion, transformation, quality validation, and troubleshooting within a Snowflake-based environment. Key Responsibilities - Develop data pipelines: Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to integrate data from source systems into Snowflake, with appropriate validation, logging, and error handling. - Implement data ingestion: Load structured and semi-structured data using Snowflake stages, file formats, COPY INTO, and Snowpipe, depending on the ingestion requirements. Snowflake Documentation - Build transformations and data models: Develop SQL transformations, tables, views, and reusable data models to support reporting and analytics. - Support incremental processing: Implement incremental loading and change data capture patterns, including Snowflake Streams where appropriate. Snowflake Documentation - Maintain quality and performance: Monitor pipeline execution, investigate data discrepancies, implement reconciliation checks, and tune SQL and warehouse usage to balance performance and cost. Snowflake Documentation - Collaborate and document: Work with analysts and application teams to understand data requirements, maintain source-to-target mappings, and document pipeline dependencies and operational procedures. Required Skills and Experience - 2–4 years of data engineering or data warehousing experience, including hands-on work with Snowflake. - Strong SQL skills, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, and troubleshooting complex queries. - Working knowledge of Snowflake databases, schemas, tables, views, virtual warehouses, stages, and data-loading processes. - Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, dimensional modeling, incremental loads, and data quality validation. - Working knowledge of Python for data processing or automation, along with Git, debugging, and clear technical communication.

title: Field Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

As a Field Engineer you will embed directly with clients to architect and build mission-critical integrations, automations, and data solutions. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you will serve as Addepar's technical vanguard - translating complex business requirements into production-grade systems while driving onboarding efficiency and operational scale. You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling - solving our clients' most challenging problems. This role combines a forward-deployed model with deep technical expertise in modern software engineering and financial data systems.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Deploy directly to client sites (virtual or in-person) to architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
* Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
* Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
* Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
* Write production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
* Lead technical workstreams end-to-end, from requirements gathering through production deployment, owning outcomes and client success
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence platform roadmap
* Develop internal tools, frameworks, and best practices that accelerate delivery across the broader team
* Effectively set, manage, and communicate technical expectations with both client stakeholders and internal cross-functional teams
* Prioritize and context-switch effectively across simultaneous client engagements, seeing each through to successful completion
* Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

#### **Who You Are**

* Minimum 3+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles
* Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks
* Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
* Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations
* Familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
* Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset and bias for action
* Outstanding communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
* Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards
* Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
* Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for client impact
* Strong work ethic, proactive approach, and high contributing teammate

**Our Values**

* **Act Like an Owner -** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together -** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients -** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation -** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning -** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

description:
### **Description**

As a **Senior Automation Test Associate Engineer**, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and stability of Davies' technology solutions through automated and manual testing. Reporting to the **Senior Manager of Development**, you will design, develop, execute, and maintain test automation solutions while working closely with Product Owners, Developers, Architects, DevOps Engineers, and business stakeholders to promote a quality-first engineering culture.

The ideal candidate will have **8-12 years of QA and Test Automation experience**, with strong expertise in test planning, test case design, automation framework development, automation coding, defect analysis, and CI/CD-integrated testing within Agile Scrum teams.

This is a hands-on role focused on delivering high-quality software through effective test automation, quality engineering best practices, risk identification, defect investigation, and continuous improvement initiatives. The position is a **permanent hybrid role based in Pune**, offering the opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovation-driven engineering environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Quality leadership and team development**

* Lead, support and develop Test Analysts and other quality practitioners, setting clear expectations and providing coaching, feedback and practical guidance.
* Champion shared ownership of quality within cross-functional teams and help squads make evidence-based decisions about coverage, risk and release readiness.
* Define and promote proportionate quality standards, testing practices and ways of working, ensuring they are understood and applied consistently.
* Build effective working relationships with Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, Delivery, Operations and other stakeholders.

**Test strategy, planning and assurance**

* Develop and maintain risk-based test strategies and plans aligned to business outcomes, technical change, delivery approach and project constraints.
* Assess change impact, dependencies and quality risks early; define suitable test levels, types, environments, data, tooling, entry and exit criteria, and evidence requirements.
* Ensure test coverage is traceable to requirements, acceptance criteria, risks and critical business processes without creating unnecessary administration.
* Plan regression, integration, system, exploratory, non-functional and user acceptance testing as appropriate to the change.
* Monitor testing progress, quality indicators, defects and residual risk, communicating concise and actionable information to relevant stakeholders.
* Contribute quality evidence and recommendations to collective release-readiness decisions; escalate material gaps or risks clearly and promptly.

**Hands-on testing and defect investigation**

* Personally design, execute and maintain tests when needed, using manual and/or automated techniques appropriate to the context.
* Undertake exploratory, functional, integration, regression and other relevant testing of new and existing functionality.
* Create clear, maintainable test cases, charters, data and evidence at a level proportionate to the risk and delivery need.
* Identify, isolate, reproduce and document defects; support root-cause analysis and verify fixes.
* Use relevant tools to inspect applications, interfaces, APIs, data and logs where required to investigate behaviour and build confidence.
* Review test assets and results produced by others, helping ensure coverage is meaningful, efficient and focused on risk.

**Automation and continuous improvement**

* Evaluate where automation will provide sustainable value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate.
* Contribute to the design, implementation or maintenance of automated checks where this matches the individual’s skills and the needs of the team.
* Work with engineers to improve testability and embed appropriate quality checks within the development and delivery lifecycle.
* Identify bottlenecks, duplication and gaps in the QA process and implement pragmatic improvements to quality, speed, coverage and transparency.
* Evaluate and recommend suitable testing tools and techniques, keeping current with relevant developments in software quality.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent applied experience.
* 10–15 years of automation and quality assurance testing experience.
* Background in web integration testing preferred.
* Strong experience in manual and automation testing, with expertise in Selenium, Playwright, frontend UI automation, backend/API automation, and end-to-end testing.
* Proven experience leading QA activities for complex products and Agile delivery teams.
* Strong test strategy, test design, exploratory testing, regression planning, and defect management skills.
* Ability to apply risk-based testing approaches and make pragmatic quality decisions.
* Experience coaching and mentoring QA engineers and driving quality best practices.
* Strong understanding of Agile, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong business awareness with the ability to evaluate customer and operational impact.
* Ability to learn new domains quickly and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

**Essential (Non-Negotiable)**

* Experience testing APIs, integrations, data flows or databases, using tools such as Postman and SQL or equivalent.
* Experience with test-management, defect-management, delivery and collaboration tools.
* Experience with automation frameworks, continuous integration pipelines, performance testing, observability or application monitoring.
* Experience working in insurance, financial services or another regulated environment.
* A relevant testing qualification such as ISTQB Foundation Level, or equivalent applied experience.

  

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

The Advanced Technical Support Engineer conducts thorough research and testing when specific product behaviours are challenged by clients and employees, articulately explains designed behaviours, acts as a champion for enhancements when appropriate, mentors junior team members, serves as a point of escalation and works closely with technology teams. They must also be able to communicate effectively with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure that Cornerstone OnDemand fulfils its commitment to providing world-class support and service. This position requires a hands-on individual, who can passionately and patiently educate our clients on, how our product is designed to work, and excels in problem solving skills, has eagerness to learn and brings customer centric mindset.

**In this role you will…**

* Own complex cases end-to-end: integrations, APIs, data issues, multi-module configuration — to Earned Resolution, not ticket closure.
* Deliver Pro Desk as the primary expert: scheduled 1:1 session that replace CSM coaching with certified product expertise.
* Take escalated Live Chat and voice — real-time expertise when the customer’s business is stuck.
* Reproduce and evidence defects: clean repro steps, logs, and breadth data that feed EIM scoring and the OneList.
* Mentor L1s daily — the 15-minute rule works because someone answers; claim hard cases at the line-up (‘I’ve got it’).
* Work AI-in-the-loop as default: copilot research, drafted responses reviewed, knowledge gaps closed.
* Pod Specialist certification within 45 days; multi-product breadth valued.

**You've got what it takes if you have…**

* 3+ years technical support with real troubleshooting depth — logs, APIs, SSO, integrations, data flows.
* Experience troubleshooting SSO, authentication, user provisioning, and identity management solutions.
* Working knowledge of SAML, OAuth, SCIM, OpenID Connect, and identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or similar platforms.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting REST APIs, web services, webhooks, connectors, and integration workflows.
* Ability to analyze logs, audit records, browser traces, and API responses to isolate and resolve technical issues.
* Experience supporting HRIS, HCM, LMS, ERP, Talent Management, or related enterprise applications and integrations.
* Knowledge of FTP/SFTP, data feeds, synchronization processes, and integration monitoring.
* Experience working with log analysis tools such as Splunk or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to independently diagnose complex customer issues and drive resolution across multiple systems and stakeholders.
* Teaching instinct: you make customers and L1s smarter in every interaction.
* Composure in escalated moments; documentation discipline that makes handoffs invisible.

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**What We Do:**

Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. title: Senior Lead, Security Development & Automation
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Senior Lead, Security Development & Automation is a hands-on technical contributor who helps protect Northern Trust by engineering automation-first security capabilities. This role supports the design and delivery of AI-enabled workflows, API integrations, playbooks, scripts and platform services that strengthen cyber defense, reduce manual operational burden and make security outcomes more consistent, measurable and repeatable. The Senior Lead works with security engineering, operations, infrastructure, application, risk, audit and technology teams to understand high-value security workflows, translate them into automation patterns and deliver solutions that improve control execution, threat response, vulnerability management, evidence collection and operational resilience.

**What You'll Do**

***Protect Northern Trust Through Security Driven Development and Automation***

* Build development and automation capabilities that help protect Northern Trust’s technology environment, reduce cyber risk and improve the consistency of security execution.
* Engineer AI agent-based workflows that support security triage, enrichment, correlation, investigation support, evidence collection, control validation and remediation orchestration.
* Create secure API integrations across security platforms, ITSM, CMDB, vulnerability management, cloud, network, identity, data and observability tools to connect signals, decisions and actions.
* Develop reliable workflow automation assets that remove friction from security operations and make high-value controls easier to operate at scale.
* Partner with security architecture, platform engineering, cloud security, IAM, threat and governance teams to apply reusable automation standards, secure engineering patterns, guardrails and operational handoffs.

***Key Deliverables***

* Develop and support security development and automation capabilities that help Northern Trust protect critical services and data, including:
  + Security workflow automation that accelerates discovery, response, remediation and control validation
  + API integrations and reusable playbooks that connect security platforms, enterprise data sources and operational systems of record
  + AI-enabled assistants and agents that improve security decision support while respecting enterprise controls, approvals and data protection requirements
  + Design and Build LLM-based vulnerability scanning and remediation solutions.

* Integrate LLM capabilities responsibly using enterprise AI platforms such as AI Foundry, approved model providers and vendor AI harnesses to enhance—not replace—security judgment and control execution.
* Develop prompt, retrieval, orchestration, testing and evaluation patterns that make AI-enabled workflows reliable, observable, secure and aligned to enterprise policy.
* Engineer automation with strong authentication, authorization, secrets handling, logging, exception handling, change control and auditability so solutions can be trusted in production security workflows.
* Document architecture, runbooks, decision logic, reusable patterns and operational handoffs so capabilities can be supported, governed and improved over time.
* Contribute to platform roadmaps, vendor integrations and automation priorities by providing practical engineering input tied to risk reduction, control effectiveness, resiliency, stability and reuse.

**What You'll Bring**

* 12+ years of experience in cybersecurity, software engineering, security automation, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation or related technology disciplines.
* Strong understanding of how development and automation can be used to protect enterprise environments, improve control execution and reduce operational risk.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical contributor: supporting solution design, contributing to architecture discussions, delivering complex technical work and helping drive adoption through collaboration and practical execution.
* Hands-on development skills in Python, including API consumption, data transformation, automation frameworks, error handling, testing and operational supportability.
* Experience integrating security, ITSM, cloud, identity, observability or data platforms through REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, workflow tools or orchestration platforms.
* Working knowledge of LLM-enabled solution patterns, AI agent workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, AI guardrails and secure use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Ability to deliver in a regulated environment with strong attention to audit-ready evidence, access controls, change management, testability, resiliency and production support.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in financial services, banking, asset servicing, wealth management or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflows, Vulnerability Response, SecOps, CMDB, ITSM integrations or similar enterprise workflow platforms.
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines or cloud-native automation patterns.
* Experience building automation for vulnerability management, exposure management, threat response, identity security, network security or cloud security operations.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Role Summary**

At Emergys, the Data Scientist – GenAI & Agentic AI will help turn business questions into practical, data-driven and AI-enabled solutions. The role combines core data science and predictive modelling with hands-on development of GenAI applications and agent components. Working with guidance from senior team members, the successful candidate will analyse data, build and test models and prototypes, and contribute to solutions that can be validated with stakeholders and developed further for production use.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with business and technical colleagues to clarify problem statements, understand available data, identify assumptions and define measurable success criteria.
* Prepare, explore and analyse structured and unstructured data using Python and SQL; assess data quality and communicate relevant findings.
* Build, test and validate analytical solutions and machine-learning models, including regression, classification, clustering, feature engineering and appropriate baseline comparisons.
* Apply statistics, experimentation and model-validation techniques to assess model performance, avoid data leakage and identify limitations.
* Contribute to GenAI applications using LLM APIs, prompt design, structured outputs, embeddings and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), selecting techniques appropriate to the use case.
* Build and test agent components such as tool/function calls, API integrations and simple multi-step workflows under guidance; support workflow orchestration and state handling.
* Implement basic safeguards and failure handling, including input validation, retries, fallback responses, clear error handling and escalation to a human when needed.
* Develop rapid proof-of-concepts, demos and analytical artifacts; iterate based on feedback and document what has been validated, what remains uncertain and what should be tested next.
* Evaluate solutions using relevant measures such as predictive performance, groundedness, accuracy, reliability, explainability, latency, cost and business usefulness.
* Collaborate with senior data scientists and engineers to improve code quality, testing, version control and readiness for deployment; contribute reusable code, prompts, evaluation cases and other accelerators.
* Explain findings and technical choices clearly to teammates and stakeholders, using visualisations or demonstrations where useful.
* Delivers well-tested models, analyses and agent components against agreed requirements and timelines.
* Demonstrates appropriate model and approach selection, supported by validation and comparison with a reasonable baseline.
* Produces measurable prototype results against defined criteria, including quality, reliability, latency and cost where relevant.
* Identifies limitations and failure cases early and documents clear next steps for improvement.
* Contributes reusable components and communicates findings in a way that helps stakeholders make decisions.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong working knowledge of Python for data analysis and application development, including readable, modular code; familiarity with common libraries such as pandas and NumPy.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying, joining and analysing data.
* Solid foundations in statistics, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, predictive modelling and model validation.
* Practical experience building and evaluating at least one or more machine-learning approaches such as regression, classification or clustering.
* Hands-on exposure to LLM-based applications and APIs, including prompt design and structured outputs; understanding of embeddings and RAG concepts.
* Foundational experience with agentic patterns such as tool/function calling, API integration and multi-step workflow execution, with a willingness to learn orchestration and state management.
* Ability to test outputs systematically and recognise failure cases, unsupported responses, data-quality issues and model limitations.
* Familiarity with Git and basic software engineering practices, including testing, debugging and documentation.
* Ability to communicate analytical findings and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to an agent or orchestration framework such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or an equivalent.
* Experience with a vector database or search platform, and with RAG evaluation or LLM evaluation tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, LangSmith or equivalent.
* Exposure to lightweight prototyping tools such as Streamlit, Gradio, notebooks or similar.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services, Docker, CI/CD, model deployment or MLOps/LLMOps concepts.
* Experience with NLP, transformer-based models, time-series analysis, optimisation or scenario modelling.
* Exposure to a business domain such as enterprise operations, manufacturing, supply chain, finance or customer service.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, or a related field is preferred.

description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an experienced AxiomSL Implementation Consultant to support a bank's regulatory reporting platform migration from OSX to AxiomSL
  
  
The successful candidate will play a key role in the end-to-end implementation and migration of regulatory reports, working closely with Regulatory Reporting, Finance, Risk, Data Management and IT teams.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on AxiomSL implementation expertise, combined with an understanding of European banking regulatory reporting requirements, data transformation, reporting logic and reconciliation processes.
  
  
The consultant will be responsible for analysing existing OSX reporting configurations, translating reporting requirements into AxiomSL solutions, implementing regulatory reports and supporting testing, reconciliation and migration activities.

##### **Responsibilities**

AxiomSL Implementation & Configuration

Design, configure, develop and implement regulatory reporting solutions within AxiomSL.

Translate regulatory reporting requirements and existing OSX reporting logic into AxiomSL configurations and technical specifications.

Develop and maintain AxiomSL data mappings, transformation rules, calculations, validations and reporting workflows.

Configure regulatory reporting templates and associated data processing logic.

Implement data ingestion and integration processes between upstream banking systems and AxiomSL.

Support both standard AxiomSL regulatory reporting packages and custom-built reporting components where required.

Troubleshoot complex technical issues involving data transformation, calculations, report generation and validation.

Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable and aligned with the bank's technical architecture and reporting standards.

OSX to AxiomSL Migration

Analyse existing OSX regulatory reporting processes, data structures, business rules and reporting configurations.

Perform gap analysis between existing OSX functionality and the target AxiomSL solution.

Identify reporting logic, calculations, data mappings and controls that require migration, redesign or enhancement.

Support migration of regulatory reporting functionality, including data transformations, validations and reporting outputs.

Work with Business Analysts and Regulatory Reporting SMEs to ensure existing regulatory requirements are accurately translated into the target solution.

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate existing reporting processes.

Support migration planning, implementation, parallel runs and production cutover activities.

Investigate and resolve differences between OSX and AxiomSL reporting outputs.

Regulatory Reporting Implementation

Support the implementation and migration of the following regulatory reports:

Liquidity Reporting

Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR)

Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR)

Additional Liquidity Monitoring Metrics (ALMM)

Prudential & Capital Reporting

Common Reporting (COREP)

Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB)

Statistical & Other Regulatory Reporting

AnaCredit

Deposit Guarantee Schemes (DGS)

BDRP

Central Electronic System of Payment Information (CESOP)

Financial & Risk Reporting

IFRS 9

Key activities include:

Understanding regulatory reporting requirements and translating them into AxiomSL configurations.

Implementing regulatory calculations, mappings, transformations and validation rules.

Ensuring accurate data aggregation and regulatory reporting outputs.

Supporting changes to regulatory taxonomies, reporting templates and validation requirements.

Working with Regulatory Reporting SMEs to investigate and resolve reporting discrepancies.

Data Mapping, Integration & Reconciliation

Analyse source data structures and map data elements to AxiomSL reporting requirements.

Develop and maintain source-to-target mappings and transformation specifications.

Support integration with upstream systems, data warehouses and other banking applications.

Implement data quality checks, reconciliation controls and exception-handling processes.

Investigate data discrepancies and ensure data completeness, accuracy and consistency.

Support end-to-end data lineage and traceability from source systems through to regulatory reporting outputs.

Identify and resolve issues affecting reporting accuracy and completeness.

Testing, Validation & Migration Support

Develop and execute unit tests for AxiomSL configurations, mappings and reporting logic.

Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and regression testing.

Perform report-level reconciliation between OSX and AxiomSL outputs.

Investigate differences in regulatory calculations, data aggregation and reporting results.

Support parallel reporting runs to validate the target AxiomSL solution.

Resolve implementation defects and support defect retesting.

Assist with production deployment, cutover and post-go-live stabilisation.

Ensure appropriate technical documentation and knowledge transfer to BAU teams.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery

Work closely with Regulatory Reporting SMEs, Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Solution Architects and Testing teams.

Participate in requirements workshops, solution design discussions and technical reviews.

Provide technical input into implementation estimates, planning and delivery dependencies.

Communicate implementation progress, technical issues and risks to project stakeholders.

Collaborate with senior business and IT stakeholders to resolve complex reporting and migration challenges.

Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards, regulatory requirements and project timelines

Must have

MUST HAVE: 5+ years of hands-on AxiomSL implementation and development experience within banking or financial services.

Proven experience implementing, configuring or enhancing regulatory reporting solutions using AxiomSL.

Strong knowledge of AxiomSL data models, data mapping, transformation rules, calculations, validations and reporting workflows.

Axiom certification

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

We are seeking an experienced and versatile **Senior ERP & Payment Integration Consultant / Engineer** with deep expertise in enterprise financial systems (**NetSuite, Oracle ERP Cloud/EBS**) and modern integration platforms (**Microservices, Workato iPaaS**).

* **Oracle ERP (Cloud / Fusion / EBS R12):**
  + Strong expertise in Oracle Payables (AP), Oracle Payments, Cash Management (CE), General Ledger (GL), and FBDI/ADFdi data ingestion.
  + Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or SOA Suite, BI Publisher reporting, and PL/SQL package development.

**3. Integration & Middleware Architecture**

  + Hands-on experience developing advanced **Workato recipes**, multi-step error-handling mechanisms, and Custom Connectors (SDK).
  + Experience utilizing Workato On-Premises Agents (OPA), Event Streams, and API Platform management.

**4. Payments, Standards & Data Formats**

* **Financial Message Standards:** Hands-on experience with **ISO 20022 XML standards** (**pain.001**, **pain.002**, **pacs.008**, **pacs.002**, **camt.053/054**), Payment Status Reports (PSR), SWIFT MT (MT101, MT940), BAI2, ACH/NACHA, and custom CSV/Flat file layouts.

* **Security & Authentication:** Strong understanding of enterprise identity and access protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC with PKCE, mTLS, SAML) and centralized secrets management (**HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk**).
