title: Default Job Template
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.

Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap

**Requirements and Preferred Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* 5 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Software Engineering, Staff
description:
Overview:

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

The Role and Team

At Medallia, our Nexus Collection & Data Platform team builds and operates the critical backend services that power how surveys are executed, distributed, processed, and collected across Nexus, Medallia’s next-generation experience management platform.

Our systems sit at the core of Nexus’s data platform and support large-scale, highly available workloads across many enterprise customers. The team owns services and capabilities related to survey execution, distribution, response processing, webhooks, messaging integrations, and the streaming pipelines that turn raw collection events into reliable, reportable data.

As Nexus continues to scale, we are evolving these systems to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency while building out key parts of the platform from the ground up on a modern, cloud-native stack.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer who enjoys solving challenging backend and distributed systems problems, working with high-throughput streaming services, and building reliable software that operates at enterprise scale. You will work closely with experienced engineers, Product Management, QA, and other platform teams to design and deliver capabilities that directly impact how millions of surveys and responses are processed across Nexus.  
  
This role is based remotely in Pune. Candidates for this position are required to reside within the Pune metropolitan area. Relocation support is not available at this time.

Responsibilities:  

* Drive resolution on open, cross-cutting architectural questions — Nexus has several live ones at any given time (e.g., which store owns a given workload and why, how a materialization strategy should be chosen and validated, how a new enrichment type should integrate without violating existing invariants). You're expected to drive these to a documented, defensible decision — not just have an opinion on them.
* Own the integrity of the platform's core data invariants across teams — multi-tenant isolation via the composite entity key model, the rule that enrichments never rewrite interaction data, and that row-level access is enforced on views rather than scattered through application logic. When a new feature threatens one of these, you're the engineer who catches it before it ships.
* Design the pipeline and schema evolution patterns other teams build against — e.g., how a dataset schema can evolve without migrations or downtime, how a new interaction type gets onboarded, how an enrichment's output reaches reporting without duplicating or destabilizing existing views.  
  Lead technical design for major cross-team initiatives — examples at this scale: extending the platform to ingest data originating from Medallia's existing products (MEC) alongside Nexus-native data, designing how AI agents (survey-building assistants, conversational feedback collection) integrate with the core data model via MCP/A2A without becoming a second, inconsistent source of truth.
* Evaluate and make build-vs-buy and store-selection decisions with real stakes — e.g., assessing whether a given workload belongs on a relational store, a wide-column store, or an OLAP engine, and what the actual operational and consistency trade-offs are, backed by a POC or benchmark rather than a hunch.
* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, data modeling for multi-tenant correctness, and how to reason about trade-offs in a system where "simple and wrong" fails silently and expensively.
* Represent engineering in architecture and design reviews across team boundaries, and be a primary author of the architecture documentation the rest of the organization builds against.
* Get hands-on when it matters — staff-level scope doesn't mean stepping back from code. You'll personally build the hardest, highest-leverage pieces of a cross-cutting initiative, especially where the design risk is too high to hand off before it's proven out.
* Improve how the platform is operated at scale — reliability, observability, and incident response patterns that work across both the application and data layers, not just within one service's boundary.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, and set the bar for how your teams evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and long-term maintainability.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership beyond your own individual contributions — driving decisions, designs, or initiatives that other engineers and teams built on top of.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems — you can reason rigorously about consistency models, failure modes, data consistency guarantees, and the real trade-offs behind an architectural decision, not just the vocabulary.
* Strong backend engineering background, ideally spanning more than one language/stack (e.g., Java and TypeScript/Node.js, or equivalent) — this role operates across Nexus Core and the Data Platform, and needs to be credible in both.
* Demonstrated experience with event-driven and streaming architectures (Kafka or equivalent, plus a stream processor such as Flink, Spark Streaming, or Kafka Streams).
* Deep experience with relational and/or wide-column data stores at scale, including schema design for systems that can't tolerate downtime or destructive changes.
* Proven experience designing for multi-tenant SaaS correctness — tenant isolation, authorization models, and the discipline required when a design mistake doesn't just cause a bug, it causes a data leak between customers.
* A track record of making and defending hard technical trade-off decisions in writing — RFCs, design docs, or equivalent — and bringing skeptical stakeholders to alignment.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction without direct management authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — at this level, your technical judgment is only as useful as your ability to convey it clearly to engineers, product, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience designing row-level or policy-based authorization systems, especially ones enforced at the data/view layer rather than purely in application code.
* Experience with identity resolution systems — matching, merging, and the operational cost of getting profile/entity resolution wrong at scale.
* Experience integrating LLM-based agents or tools into a production platform, especially using protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) or agent-to-agent (A2A) coordination.
* Experience leading a platform migration or hybrid-integration effort — e.g., bringing a legacy system's data into a new platform without forcing customers through a disruptive migration.

title: Software Engineering, Senior
description:
Overview:

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

The Role and Team

At Medallia, our Nexus Collection & Data Platform team builds and operates the critical backend services that power how surveys are executed, distributed, processed, and collected across Nexus, Medallia’s next-generation experience management platform.

Our systems sit at the core of Nexus’s data platform and support large-scale, highly available workloads across many enterprise customers. The team owns services and capabilities related to survey execution, distribution, response processing, webhooks, messaging integrations, and the streaming pipelines that turn raw collection events into reliable, reportable data.

As Nexus continues to scale, we are evolving these systems to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency while building out key parts of the platform from the ground up on a modern, cloud-native stack.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who enjoys solving challenging backend and distributed systems problems, working with high-throughput streaming services, and building reliable software that operates at enterprise scale.

You will work closely with experienced engineers, Product Management, QA, and other platform teams to design and deliver capabilities that directly impact how millions of surveys and responses are processed across Nexus.

This role is based remotely in Pune. Candidates for this position are required to reside within the Pune metropolitan area. Relocation support is not available at this time.

Responsibilities:

* Design, implement, test, and maintain backend services and features for Nexus’s Collection and Data Platform.
* Build scalable and reliable systems that support high-volume survey distribution, response processing, and data collection workflows.
* Work with distributed and event-driven architectures, including asynchronous processing, Kafka-based messaging (MSK), and stream processing with Apache Flink.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs, webhooks, and integrations with internal and external systems.
* Analyze performance and scalability challenges and contribute to improvements in throughput, latency, reliability, and resource utilization across the ingestion and streaming pipeline.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, Product Managers, QA, and other engineering teams to clarify requirements, evaluate technical solutions, and deliver features incrementally.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement solutions that improve system reliability and prevent recurrence.
* Participate in the team’s on-call rotation and contribute to monitoring, observability, and operational improvements.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and actively participate in code reviews and technical design discussions.
* Contribute to the continuous evolution of Nexus’s collection and streaming architecture while maintaining compatibility with large-scale, multi-tenant production environments.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity while validating generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Share technical knowledge within the team and contribute to engineering best practices.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of backend software development experience, preferably using Java.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience designing, implementing, or maintaining backend services or APIs.
* Experience working with relational databases and writing efficient database queries.
* Understanding of distributed systems concepts, asynchronous processing, concurrency, and service-oriented architectures.
* Experience writing automated tests and debugging production software.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools, combined with the ability to critically review and validate generated code.
* Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with Apache Kafka or other event-driven/message-based architectures.
* Experience with Apache Flink or other stream-processing frameworks (Spark Streaming, Kafka Streams, or similar).
* Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
* Experience with wide-column/KV stores such as Cassandra, AWS Keyspaces, or DynamoDB.
* Experience building or integrating REST APIs and webhooks.
* Experience designing or operating high-throughput, highly available distributed systems.
* Familiarity with scalability, performance tuning, caching, retries, idempotency, and fault-tolerant system design.
* Experience with OLAP/analytical engines (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Druid, or similar).
* Experience with monitoring, observability, production troubleshooting, and incident management.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and modern software development workflows.
* Experience working with large-scale SaaS platforms or multi-tenant enterprise systems.

The selected candidate will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and support of AS400-based systems while supporting MetLife’s broader digital transformation agenda.

* Strong hands-on experience in COBOL programming and IBM AS400 / IBM i-Series platforms.

* Solid understanding of application design, architecture, system integration, and data flows.

* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Stable and reliable operation of AS400-based critical systems.

* Efficient handling of incidents with minimal business disruption.

* Continuous enhancement and optimization of legacy platforms.

* Strong alignment with business needs, Agile team commitments, sprint goals, and delivery timelines.

  
  
  

**About MetLife**  
  

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s #AllTogetherPossible. Join us!

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Digital S/W Engineer Sr Analyst Shape, build, and govern high-impact API solutions as a Senior Systems Engineer, sitting at the intersection of hands-on Apigee development and API design leadership within Citi's Digital Engineering organization. In this hybrid technical role, you will both develop and configure production API solutions on Google Apigee and lead the design and specification of API interfaces and integration patterns — owning mid-size features end-to-end from architecture through deployment, while contributing to larger platform initiatives.

  
  

You will be equally comfortable configuring Apigee proxies and policies as you are producing API design artefacts, leading design reviews, and governing integration standards. This role sits within Citi's Wealth Digital engineering team, where your contributions will directly shape API quality, security posture, and delivery outcomes at scale.

  
  

Responsibilities

  
  

Apigee

* Design and configure API proxies on Google Apigee, including proxy configurations, flow definitions, route rules, and target endpoint setup.

* Define and maintain Apigee policies — including traffic management (quota, spike arrest, rate limiting), mediation (JSON-to-XML, message transformation), and security (OAuth, API key validation, JWT verification) policies.

* Implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) authorization flows natively within Apigee, including authorization code, client credentials, and token introspection patterns.

* Configure and manage Apigee environments, API products, developer portals, and monetization configurations in line with platform governance standards.

* Integrate Apigee with backend services, identity providers, and downstream systems through secure, performant target configurations.

  
  

API Design & Governance

* Lead the design and specification of RESTful APIs, producing OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, API contracts, and integration specifications that engineering teams implement against.

* Apply Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles in both API design specifications and Apigee proxy configurations to protect sensitive financial data exchanges.

* Apply knowledge of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CDR, Section 1033) to design and build compliant, interoperable API interfaces on the Apigee platform.

* Define and enforce API design standards and governance guidelines, governing APIGEE Products and Proxies ,including naming conventions, versioning strategies, error response schemas, and pagination patterns.

* Facilitate and lead API design reviews and architecture walkthroughs, providing well-reasoned recommendations that guide engineering implementation decisions.

* Produce technical diagrams — sequence diagrams, flow diagrams, and system context maps — to document API behavior, data flows, Apigee policy execution, and integration touchpoints.

  
  

Leadership & Collaboration

* Communicate technical progress and risks proactively across engineering and product teams, managing competing priorities and keeping stakeholders aligned.

* Review delivery and API quality metrics regularly, identifying opportunities to improve development workflows, proxy performance, and governance processes.

* Mentor and upskill junior engineers through code reviews, proxy design walkthroughs, and structured knowledge-sharing sessions.

* Evaluate technical and business risk in design and implementation decisions, escalating issues with transparency to protect Citi and its clients.

  
  

Required Qualifications & Skills

* 8–10 years of experience in a product development, engineering, or technology product management environment, including 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and configuring APIs on Google Apigee (proxies, flow configurations, policy chaining, shared flows, and target endpoints).

* Advanced expertise in RESTful API design & architecture, OpenAPI 3.x specification authoring, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Deep knowledge of API security & identity standards, including OAuth 2.0 (OAuthV2 policies, Client Credentials), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles across API contracts and Apigee configurations.

* Strong understanding of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CFPB Section 1033) and global data privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) to ensure compliant, interoperable interface design.

* Skilled in vendor and partner management, effectively collaborating with third-party service providers to evaluate tools and drive solution delivery.

* Hands-on delivery in Agile environments, applying Scrum/Kanban practices to lead cross-functional sprint teams from concept through deployment.

* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with a data-driven, results-oriented approach to resolving complex system challenges and optimizing delivery metrics.

* Working familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Devin.AI) and prompt engineering methodologies to improve design velocity and documentation quality.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven capability to influence both senior technical and business stakeholders, articulate technical trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design walkthroughs.

Education

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Power Platform Engineer
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Power Platform Engineer to design, build, secure, and support enterprise-grade solutions using Microsoft Power Platform. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, integrations, governance, and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

  

* **Role: Senior Power Platform Engineer**
* **Location: All Persistent locations**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps using Microsoft Power Platform.
* Develop Power Automate Cloud Flows and approved Desktop Flows to streamline business processes.
* Build robust solutions utilizing Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL Server, enterprise APIs, and approved connectors.
* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable solution designs, data models, integrations, and deployment plans.
* Create reusable components, templates, accelerators, and development standards to improve delivery efficiency.
* Optimize application usability, maintainability, performance, and scalability.
* Implement Power Platform environment strategies and governance frameworks.
* Utilize managed solutions, solution layering, connection references, and environment variables effectively.
* Establish source control and version management practices for Power Platform assets.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines across development, testing, and production environments.
* Develop secure integrations using Custom Connectors, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, and enterprise APIs.
* Assess and address non-functional requirements including performance, availability, recovery, maintainability, and operational supportability.
* Configure and enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies.
* Implement role-based access controls (RBAC), least-privilege access models, and environment governance policies.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, audit, and data governance requirements.
* Support platform inventory management, licensing optimization, environment governance, and Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives.
* Implement monitoring and governance controls to ensure sustainable platform growth and operational excellence.
* Develop and support unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, security testing, and user acceptance testing activities.
* Monitor application performance, platform health, and user adoption metrics.
* Investigate incidents, troubleshoot application issues, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Maintain operational documentation, support runbooks, deployment guides, and release records.
* Support production deployments and ongoing application maintenance activities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Security Teams, Architects, Data Teams, Risk Teams, and Operations Teams.
* Provide technical guidance and coaching to citizen developers, makers, and development teams.
* Conduct peer reviews and contribute to development standards and governance practices.
* Promote engineering best practices, supportability standards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support organizational adoption of Power Platform capabilities and governance frameworks.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-12 years of experience in application development, enterprise platforms, or low-code solution engineering.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse.
* Hands-on expertise in developing Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Strong experience designing and implementing Power Automate Cloud Flows.
* Expertise in data modelling, relational data structures, and Dataverse architecture.
* Experience working with SharePoint, SQL Server, REST APIs, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong understanding of Power Platform ALM concepts including managed solutions, solution deployment, and environment management.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of Custom Connectors, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and API Management.
* Strong understanding of security, governance, DLP policies, RBAC, and compliance controls.
* Experience working with Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) frameworks and governance models.
* Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and documentation abilities.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps delivery environments.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

description:

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer** to develop, maintain, secure, test, and support enterprise integration solutions connecting complex business applications and services.

This role combines Java application development, systems integration, software security, automated deployment, application testing, and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience developing and supporting integrations using web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity within a secure enterprise environment.

The engineer is also expected to effectively use approved artificial intelligence-assisted development tools, including Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle to improve development efficiency, testing effectiveness, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall code quality. All AI-assisted output must be appropriately reviewed, validated, secured, and tested prior to implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and support secure, scalable Java-based enterprise integration solutions using REST and SOAP web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, interface, data-processing, and service-related issues while implementing enhancements to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
* Apply secure software-development practices and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security testing while maintaining system functionality and reliability.
* Manage application security requirements, including certificate, credential, and password rotations, and resolve related authentication and authorization issues.
* Maintain and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Support application releases, deployment validation, production issue resolution, and appropriate testing of application changes prior to implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, interfaces, deployment processes, and supported solutions.
* The successful candidate is expected to incorporate approved AI-assisted development tools into day-to-day engineering activities, including:
* Accelerating code development, refactoring, integration development, and maintenance of existing solutions.
* Supporting development and refinement of unit and integration tests, code reviews, defect identification, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Assisting with analysis and remediation of application security findings.
* Supporting build and deployment automation, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Identifying opportunities to responsibly use AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 9+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise application using Java 8 or later and Spring Framework.
* Experience developing and supporting web services, application programming interfaces, and relational database integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues.
* Experience with source control, automated build and deployment pipelines, and modern software-development lifecycle practices.
* Knowledge of secure software-development practices, including application vulnerability identification, security testing, and remediation.
* Experience with application security concepts, including digital certificates, credentials, authentication, authorization, and password management.
* Experience developing and executing unit, integration, regression, and interface testing.
* Strong technical documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting complex, business-critical enterprise applications and integrations.
* Experience modernizing or migrating on-premises application and integrations to cloud-based environments.
* Experience with application security, certificate and credential management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience using Copilot or similar approved AI-assisted development tools to enhance software development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to independently investigate complex issues and drive them through resolution.
* Strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to effectively collaborate across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability for assigned solutions throughout the development and support lifecycle.
* Adaptability and willingness to adopt new technologies, tools, and development practices, including responsible use of AI-assisted capabilities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and engineering efficiency.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.

**About the role**

The **Manager, Network Security Engineering and Operations** will provide technical and operational leadership for enterprise network security services across traditional firewall, remote-access, identity-based access, and cloud-delivered Zero Trust technologies. **12 to 16 years** of experience in enterprise networking or network security, including substantial experience in technical leadership or service management.

Demonstrated experience managing Network Security engineering or operations teams in a large, distributed enterprise

The role will be accountable for service strategy, architecture governance, engineering delivery, operational stability, security compliance, major-incident leadership, and team capability across:

* Enterprise firewalls, preferably Cisco ASA/FTD and Palo Alto Networks
* Remote Access VPN using Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
* Site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Cisco Identity Services Engine
* Zscaler Internet Access
* Zscaler Private Access
* Zero Trust Network Access and Secure Access Service Edge

**In this role, you will:**

### **1. Service Ownership and Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise Network Security services, including strategy, architecture, engineering, transition, operations and optimisation
* Establish clear service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths and accountability across internal technology teams.
* Define annual service roadmaps covering platform upgrades, security improvements, automation, technology refresh, resilience and legacy retirement.
* Manage service performance, capacity, availability, risks, dependencies, technical debt and operational readiness.
* Act as the management escalation point for significant service, delivery, stakeholder and vendor issues.
* Balance operational stability with security transformation and business delivery priorities.

### **2. Architecture and Design Governance**

* Provide design authority for network security solutions across corporate environments, data centres, remote users, cloud platforms, business units, merged entities and isolated environments.
* Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, security patterns, traffic-flow diagrams, migration approaches, implementation plans and operational acceptance criteria.
* Govern technical standards for firewalls, RAVPN, IPSec tunnels, Cisco ISE, ZIA, ZPA, App Connectors, traffic forwarding and endpoint posture.
* Ensure architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, least privilege, segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.

### **3. Technology and Engineering Leadership**

Maintain sufficient technical depth to guide engineering teams, challenge vendor recommendations, approve designs and support critical escalations across the following domains:

**Firewalls**

* Cisco ASA/FTD, Firewall Management Center, Palo Alto Networks and Panorama
* Security policies, ACLs, NAT, segmentation, routing and high availability
* IPS/IDS, URL filtering, SSL inspection and threat prevention
* Rule optimisation, recertification and removal of obsolete policies
* Platform lifecycle, patching and vulnerability remediation

**Remote Access and IPSec VPN**

* Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect architecture
* SSL VPN, IKEv1/IKEv2 and site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Authentication, authorization, SAML, RADIUS and certificates
* Tunnel profiles, split tunnelling, routing, NAT and resiliency
* Migration from conventional VPN access to application-based Zero Trust access

**Cisco ISE**

* Authentication and authorization policies
* RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, profiling and posture
* Certificate and identity integrations
* VPN posture, device compliance and access enforcement
* Node health, upgrades, high availability and disaster recovery

**Zscaler ZIA and ZPA**

* ZIA traffic forwarding through ZCC, GRE, IPSec, Cloud Connectors and service edges
* URL filtering, SSL inspection, DNS security, cloud firewall, threat prevention and DLP integration
* ZPA App Connectors, application segments, access policies, Browser Access, posture and identity integration
* Managed, unmanaged and isolated-device access patterns
* App Connector placement, capacity, application discovery and segmentation
* ZIA/ZPA policy governance, administrative access and logging

4. Operations, Delivery and Problem Management

* Ensure effective L3/L4 support for firewall, RAVPN, IPSec, ISE, ZIA and ZPA services.
* Lead or oversee P1/P2 incidents, technical war rooms and executive escalations.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across network, security, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, vendor and service-management teams.
* Ensure Network Security platforms comply with corporate security baselines, internal standards and applicable control frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate Security and Audit teams to provide evidence for firewall governance, endpoint posture, identity enforcement, vulnerability remediation and access controls.
* Support NIST, ISO, internal audit and regulatory evidence requirements as applicable.
* Lead security transformation programmes involving RAVPN-to-ZPA migration, firewall optimisation, application segmentation and cloud-security adoption.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Network Security engineers and technical leads.
* Build effective relationships with Corporate Security, Architecture, IAM, Endpoint, Cloud, Network Operations, Service Management and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical issues and risks into clear business impact, decisions and investment requirements.
* Manage engineering and escalation relationships with Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and implementation partners.
* Review vendor proposals, statements of work, architecture recommendations and product roadmaps.
* Hold vendors accountable for defect resolution, root-cause findings, security fixes, platform reliability and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate complex incidents and interoperability issues involving multiple providers.
* Ensure all material decisions, responsibilities and dependencies are captured through documented RACI and governance structures.

**These will help you succeed**

### **Preferred Certifications**

* CCNP Security or equivalent Cisco security certification
* Palo Alto Networks PCNSE
* Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Administrator or Zscaler Digital Transformation certification
* ITIL Foundation or advanced IT service-management certification
* Relevant cloud certification in Azure, AWS or GCP

**Work model –**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune, Maharashtra. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a skilled Data Modeler with strong expertise in data modeling, data architecture, and ETL/ELT engineering to support enterprise data transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will design and maintain scalable data models that enable analytics, reporting, and business intelligence solutions while ensuring data quality, consistency, and governance across the organization. This role requires a strong understanding of relational and dimensional modeling techniques, data integration frameworks, database technologies, and modern data engineering practices. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, and architects to build robust data foundations that support data-driven decision-making.

  

* **Role: Data Modeler**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: Between 5 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with business requirements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, analysts, and engineering teams to gather and analyze data requirements.
* Translate business processes and reporting requirements into scalable and maintainable data models.
* Develop and optimize dimensional models including star schemas and snowflake schemas for analytics and reporting.
* Implement and support ETL/ELT data integration processes to ensure high-quality and consistent data delivery.
* Design and document data lineage, metadata, data dictionaries, and business glossaries.
* Evaluate and improve existing data models for scalability, flexibility, and performance.
* Partner with data engineering teams to ensure alignment between data architecture and implementation.
* Support enterprise reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, and advanced analytics initiatives.
* Participate in data governance, master data management, and data quality improvement programs.
* Perform data analysis and profiling to identify data issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Create technical documentation, standards, and best practices for data modeling and integration.
* Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and modern data architecture practices.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 5–8 years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, or Data Engineering roles.
* Proven experience designing enterprise data models for large-scale business applications and analytics platforms.
* Strong expertise with data modeling tools such as ERwin Data Modeler, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, ER/Studio, Similar enterprise modeling solutions.
* Strong understanding of Conceptual Data Modeling, Logical Data Modeling, Physical Data Modeling, Relational Data Modeling, Dimensional Data Modeling.
* Expertise in designing Star Schema and Snowflake Schema architectures.
* Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools and frameworks including Informatica, Talend, Apache NiFi, Similar integration platforms.
* Strong SQL development and query optimization skills.
* Experience working with enterprise databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL.
* Strong understanding of Data Warehousing concepts and best practices.
* Knowledge of data integration, transformation, and migration methodologies.
* Experience with metadata management and data lineage documentation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working within Agile and cross-functional delivery teams.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own platform deployment** for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* **Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* **Architect for scale and resilience** — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* **Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers**, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems.
* **Manage model-hosting strategy**, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* **Build observability and monitoring** for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* **Drive security, compliance, and governance** of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* **Optimize infrastructure cost and performance**, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* **Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap**, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

  

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5–8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments.
* Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling
* Understanding of model-hosting economics, GPU resource management, and inference optimization techniques (quantization, batching, caching).
* Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

  

**Soft Skills / Leadership**

* Proven ability to lead engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working with Data SMEs, Product, Responsible AI, and business stakeholders.
* Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership.
* Comfortable operating in a "zero to one" environment — building platform foundations rather than maintaining existing ones.

  

**What We Offer:**

* A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact.
* Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement.
* A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth.
* Comprehensive support and guidance to develop into a transformative leader, equipped to navigate and excel in today's rapidly evolving technological landscape.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
Senior Vice President, POM Product Management

We're seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Management. This role is located in Pune, India.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways

* **Product strategy:** define and execute the product strategy for enterprise data capabilities, aligning the roadmap to DSS priorities, platform needs, business outcomes, and the firm's broader data and AI strategy.
* **Authoritative data masters:** own the product roadmap for increasing enterprise consumption of authoritative data masters, including Unified Client Master, Unified Product Master, Security Master, and related reference-data capabilities.
* **Migration and adoption:** partner with platforms and hubs to identify where local, fragmented, or duplicative data sources remain in use, and develop practical migration and adoption plans toward authoritative enterprise masters.
* **Requirements and delivery:** convert platform adoption barriers into prioritized product requirements, backlogs, milestones, ownership, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and measurable delivery outcomes, using Agile/SAFe practices including PI planning.
* **Resiliency through modernization:** identify product priorities that strengthen resilience, reduce dependency on legacy data infrastructure, simplify integration patterns, and improve the reliability of foundational data services.
* **Data quality:** define product capabilities that improve data-quality issue detection, triage, remediation, feedback loops, and accountability for data at its source.
* **Governance:** embed ownership, lineage, metadata, data-quality standards, permissible-use expectations, and regulatory requirements into product design and delivery.
* **Accessibility through Data Mesh:** make governed enterprise data easier to register, certify, discover, access, and reuse across reporting, analytics, business applications, and AI-enabled solutions.
* **Commercial value through Data Products:** identify reusable data-product opportunities, validate demand, define target consumers, connect products to measurable use cases, and track adoption and realized benefits.
* **Consumption experience:** shape capabilities such as APIs, events, self-service onboarding, reusable integration patterns, reference implementations, and implementation guidance that make authoritative data easier for platforms to consume.
* **Product measures:** define and track measures at the platform and application level, including master-data consumption, adoption progress, data-product usage, implementation milestones, service performance, and business outcomes.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Operations, Governance, Risk, Finance, and business teams to align investment, sequencing, delivery capacity, controls, and adoption commitments.
* **Full product lifecycle:** lead from discovery and prioritization through delivery, release, adoption, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
* **Executive communication:** communicate strategy, progress, value, risks, dependencies, and decisions through concise, data-driven materials for senior business and technology stakeholders.
* **Trusted advisor and global partner:** act as a senior product leader who influences platforms and hubs that consume DSS capabilities without directly owning their engineering resources, and connects DSS product teams in Pune with stakeholders across regions and time zones.
* **Building the team:** over time, hire, coach, and lead Product Owners and Product Managers, and grow the DSS product capability in Pune, while continuing to own key products yourself.

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; Master's/MBA a plus.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of product management, data-product, platform-product, or related technology-delivery experience.
* **Enterprise delivery:** experience managing product roadmaps and end-to-end delivery in a complex enterprise environment.
* **Enterprise data depth:** strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, master/reference data, APIs, governance, and data quality.
* **Influence and execution:** demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional execution, including across geographies.
* **AI fluency:** credible understanding of how modern AI/GenAI depends on governed, high-quality data, and hands-on use of AI tools to accelerate product work.
* **Hands-on mindset:** recent, direct experience writing requirements, owning backlogs, and working day to day with engineers and data teams; comfortable being an individual contributor at a senior level.
* **Leadership readiness:** experience mentoring or leading product practitioners, or clear readiness to do so, with the judgment to balance personal delivery with developing others.

Preferred qualifications

* Financial services or other regulated-industry experience.
* Experience with client, product, or security master data and reference-data programs.
* Experience with Data Mesh, data-product operating models, data catalogs, or data contracts.
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations for data, such as BCBS 239, data privacy, and data residency.
* Experience moving from a senior individual-contributor role into people leadership, or building a product team from a small base.
* Experience working in or with a global capability centre in India.

title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  
  

Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.

  
  

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).

  

**We will count on you to:**

  

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
* You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
* You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
* Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
* Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation
  

**What you need to have:**

  

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.
* 12+ years of total experience
* Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
* You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
* A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
* Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
* Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent
  

**What makes you stand out:**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently
  

**Why join our team:**

  

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

  
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

**Role Summary :** The ServiceNow Engineering Lead – IT Asset Management will provide end-to-end technical leadership and delivery ownership for the IT Asset Management product/POD, covering CMDB, Hardware Asset Management (HAM), Software Asset Management (SAM) with Flexera integration, Application Portfolio Management (APM), Discovery, Service Graph Connectors, and enterprise integrations.

The role will serve as the technical SPOC for the IT Asset Management product, combining strong ServiceNow engineering expertise with ITAM domain knowledge and business acumen to translate business, operational, risk, regulatory, and technology requirements into scalable and sustainable platform services.

* Service Graph Connector & Discovery Engineering

* Hardware Asset Management  
  Lead HAM capabilities covering procurement/receiving interfaces, hardware lifecycle, stockrooms, transfer orders, Asset-CI synchronization, asset audits, attestations, reconciliation, retirement and disposal.
* Software Asset Management & Flexera  
  Lead SAM capabilities covering software inventory, normalization, entitlement and consumption data, compliance, reconciliation, reclamation and integration with Flexera.
* Application Portfolio Management

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
